InitContainer installs curl/jq; include readiness/liveness probes; Namespace NetworkPolicy restricts egress to the image registry. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace static-site-serve: a Deployment running nginx with 2 replicas, mounting a PVC at /usr/share/nginx/html for static files, a ConfigMap site-content for index.html/assets, and a Secret for basic auth credentials; also mount a nginx.conf from another ConfigMap to enable basic auth. Expose via a ClusterIP Service. Add readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace-wide ResourceQuota and LimitRange to cap CPU/memory. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

CKAD advanced: design a per-namespace data-pipeline controller using a CRD NamespaceDataPipeline. Each instance subscribes to a namespaced NATS subject (metrics.{namespace}) and writes batched data to a TSDB. Guarantee at-least-once via a DLQ on a PVC and idempotent writes. Include InitContainer for deps, a TLS-rotation sidecar, a ConfigMap for BATCH_SIZE, a Secret for creds, readiness/liveness probes, and a NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the TSDB. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace secure-webapp: a Deployment running a small Python Flask app using a non-root user, with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, and securityContext to drop all capabilities. Expose via a ClusterIP Service. Create a Namespace with a LimitRange (min/max CPU/memory) and a ResourceQuota for pods, services, and requests. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace 'db-migrate' workflow: a Deployment 'webapp' (2 replicas) uses a PVC-backed /data and an InitContainer that runs a migration binary before the app starts. After migration, the app should begin serving. Add a readinessProbe on /health and livenessProbe on /ready, resource requests, a 10s preStop, and a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 1 healthy pod. Provide a minimal manifest patch and a test plan to verify migration idempotence and rollback?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace database-migration pipeline: a CronJob in each namespace triggers a Job that runs a SQL schema migration against the tenant database service in that namespace, sourcing the script from a ConfigMap and credentials from a Secret, using an InitContainer to install a SQL client, mounting a PVC at /logs to store the run logs, with readiness/liveness probes on the Pod, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy that restricts egress to the tenant DB endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace config-reloader: a Deployment that mounts a ConfigMap as /config, watches for changes using a lightweight inotify-based watcher to trigger a SIGHUP reload of the main process, and POSTs a change-summary to http://config-portal:7000/api/v1/reload; include InitContainer to install inotify-tools, a Secret for API creds, a TLS-sidecar for cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace canary-queue controller: a Deployment reads a PVC-mounted /canary/queue.yaml listing canary tests (name, namespace, image). For each entry, create a Job that runs a 1-time smoke test against the target image, batch tests using BATCH_SIZE from a ConfigMap named canary-config, and POST a summary to http://canary-portal:7070/api/v1/results. Include InitContainer to install curl, a Secret for API creds, TLS sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace secret-compliance-checker: a Deployment that periodically reads Secrets mounted into /secrets from a PVC, validates key names against an allowlist defined in a ConfigMap named secret-allowlist (e.g., allowed keys: tls.key, tls.crt, creds), and POSTs a per-namespace digest to http://compliance-portal:7000/api/v1/digest. Include InitContainer to install jq/yq, a Secret for API creds, a TLS sidecar for cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In namespace analytics, create a CronJob named 'db-backfill' that runs daily at 02:00 to execute a Postgres backfill against db.analytics.svc.cluster.local:5432. Mount /scripts from ConfigMap 'backfill-scripts' and load credentials from Secret 'db-creds' as envs. Use image postgres:15-alpine; run psql to /scripts/backfill.sql. Set concurrencyPolicy: Forbid, backoffLimit: 3, successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and explain verification and rollback steps?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace canary-automation pattern: a CronJob runs every 5 minutes to promote a canary release based on a ConfigMap named canary-config that contains targetImage and canaryPercent for the Deployment in the same namespace. A separate canary-status ConfigMap records last rollout status; patch the Deployment to roll out the new image using RollingUpdate (maxSurge:1, maxUnavailable:0) and traffic shifting for canary pods. Logs go to a PVC mounted at /logs. InitContainer installs jq; add readiness/liveness probes; Namespace NetworkPolicy restricts egress to the private registry. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace analytics, design a CronJob-based log-cleaner that runs hourly to prune and compress logs on a PVC mounted at /logs/app, retaining days defined in a ConfigMap named log-retention. The Job should gzip rotated logs, prune files older than retention, and post a summary to http://log-portal:8080/api/v1/retention-summary. InitContainer installs gzip/pigz, use a Secret for API creds, a TLS sidecar for cert rotation, with readiness/liveness probes and a network policy restricting egress to the portal. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and explain how you'd test rollbacks?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace feature-toggle proxy: a Deployment running an NGINX-based reverse proxy that reads a ConfigMap named feature-flags (key enableFeatureX) and a Secret proxy-cred for basic auth. The proxy forwards to app-service only when the flag is true; otherwise returns 503. Include an InitContainer to install jq, a templated nginx.conf, a TLS rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to app-service. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In namespace audit, design a 2-replica Deployment 'auditor' that watches a PVC mounted at /audits for YAML manifests. For each file seen, run kubectl apply --dry-run=server to validate, and yamllint to check syntax. Batch results using BATCH_SIZE from audit-config ConfigMap, and POST a summary to http://audit-portal:8080/api/v1/audit every batch. Include an InitContainer to install kubectl and yamllint, a Secret for API creds, a TLS sidecar for rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace database-migration CronJob that applies SQL scripts stored in a ConfigMap to a target database exposed as a Service in the same namespace. Use a Secret for DB credentials, log output to a PVC at /logs, and persist last-run state in a namespace ConfigMap named migration-status. Include an InitContainer to install psql and readiness/liveness probes. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-promo pipeline: a CronJob in the source namespace reads target tag from a ConfigMap, authenticates to a private registry via a Secret, fetches the digest, patches the Deployment in the destination namespace. InitContainer installs kubectl/jq; logs go to /logs on a PVC; last digest stored in a ConfigMap in the destination; add readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting registry egress. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace TLS certificate rotation task: a CronJob runs every 15 minutes to fetch a TLS cert and private key from an internal CA via REST using an API_TOKEN from a Secret, updates a Secret in the same namespace, and refreshes the Ingress TLS secret. Logs go to a PVC at /logs; InitContainer installs curl and jq; include readiness/liveness probes; Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the CA endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-policy scanner: a Deployment named image-scan-agent that runs in a single namespace, mounts a PVC at /scans, and uses a ConfigMap image-policy-config with two keys: ALLOWED_REGISTRIES and DISALLOWED_TAGS. Include an InitContainer to install kubectl and jq, and a small script that lists all Deployments in the namespace, extracts container images, and flags any image whose tag is latest or not in an ALLOWED_REGISTRIES; write a digest.json summary to /scans each run. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace config-reloader: a Deployment that mounts a PVC at /configs with YAML files, validates them in an InitContainer using yamllint, and signals the main server to reload configuration when a YAML changes using a simple sidecar that touches a shared /reload/trigger file. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton, include readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to internal endpoints. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-approval gate: a Deployment tails /images for Dockerfiles on a PVC, parses FROM lines, resolves base digests with skopeo (InitContainer installs it), and verifies pins against an allowlist in a ConfigMap. Writes a report to /reports and exits non-zero on unpinned base. Include a Secret for registry creds, a TLS sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

CKAD advanced: Design a per-namespace policy-enforcement flow using a MutatingAdmissionWebhook that auto-injects resource requests/limits into Pods lacking them. The webhook reads defaults from a ConfigMap (e.g., default_cpu: 125m, default_memory: 128Mi) with per-namespace overrides; a Secret stores a token to fetch policy updates from an in-cluster policy store. Include a minimal webhook Deployment, MutatingWebhookConfiguration, and a per-namespace test namespace. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace event-forwarder as a Deployment that tails /var/log/events/*.log from a PVC, InitContainer installs curl/jq, reads BATCH_SIZE and a jq filter from ConfigMap forward-config, and uses a Secret for API creds. It batches and POSTs JSON to http://event-collector:7000/api/v1/events; TLS cert-rotation sidecar; readiness/liveness probes; Namespace NetworkPolicy restricts egress to internal. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace metrics-collector Deployment: a Pod reads METRICS_TARGET and METRICS_ENDPOINTS from a ConfigMap and API_TOKEN from a Secret; every minute, it curls each endpoint to POST a heartbeat with a timestamp, writes logs to a PVC at /logs, and uses an InitContainer to install curl. Add readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the metrics endpoints. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace 'prod', a Deployment 'payments-api' with multiple replicas risks resource contention under peak load. You must enforce per-namespace resource discipline. Create a ResourceQuota and a LimitRange; provide minimal manifests and describe validation under load?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace config-schema-validator: a CronJob in the target namespace that runs every 7 minutes to fetch a JSON Schema URL from ConfigMap validation-config, validate all ConfigMaps in the namespace with jq, and POST a summary to http://validation-portal:8080/api/v1/validate. InitContainer installs curl/jq; Secret stores API creds; logs to PVC /logs; persist status in ConfigMap validation-status; Namespace NetworkPolicy restricts egress to the schema URL and portal. Minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-scan pipeline: a Deployment watches a PVC-mounted /manifests directory containing Kubernetes manifest YAMLs, extracts container images, runs Trivy against a local DB, batches results per BATCH_SIZE from a ConfigMap named scan-config, and POSTs a summary to http://scan-portal:8080/api/v1/summary. Include InitContainer to install Trivy, a Secret for API creds, a TLS sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace cost-collector: a Deployment tails /mnt/metrics/usage.jsonl from a PVC, aggregates a 5-minute rolling sum per pod label, writes the result to /summaries/latest.json, and serves it on port 8080 with a tiny built-in HTTP server. Include an InitContainer to install jq, a Secret for API credentials, a TLS cert rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace outbound allowlist manager: a CronJob in each namespace reads allowedHosts from a ConfigMap, resolves to IPs, and updates a namespace NetworkPolicy to permit egress only to those CIDRs on port 443. A separate Job tests reachability from pods and stores results to a PVC at /logs. InitContainer installs curl; include readiness/liveness probes and a default-deny egress. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace data-collection and delivery pipeline: a Deployment named data-collector reads files from a namespace-scoped PVC mounted at /data, computes a rolling summary every N files, and a CronJob in the same namespace triggers every 5 minutes to POST the latest summary to an external API using a Bearer token from a Secret, while persisting raw/summary logs to a PVC at /logs. Use an InitContainer to install curl, include readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the external API endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace log-archival-agent: Deployment tails /var/log/app/*.log from a PVC mounted in the Pod, batches logs into 256-line blocks, compresses with gzip, and POSTs to a central endpoint http://log-archive.local:8123/api/v1/archive. Include an InitContainer to install gzip and socat, a Secret for API credentials, a TLS cert-rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace audit-logger that watches Pod creations within the target namespace and triggers a batch digest + report. When a Pod with label app=secure is created, the controller (a small Deployment) should: 1) write a digest of Pod metadata to a ConfigMap named audit-digest; 2) post a heartbeat including the digest and timestamp to a central endpoint using a Bearer token stored in a Secret named audit-token; 3) emit logs to a PVC at /logs; 4) be wired with an InitContainer to install curl and jq; 5) include readiness/liveness probes; 6) apply a Namespace NetworkPolicy that only allows egress to the audit-portal. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, implement per-namespace resource governance: a Namespace ResourceQuota to cap total pod memory and CPU, a corresponding LimitRange for per-pod requests/limits, and a Deployment in that namespace that creates pods hitting the quota. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace hardening, design a per-namespace audit CronJob that scans all Deployments for containers with securityContext.runAsNonRoot != true or readOnlyRootFilesystem != true, and writes a remediation plan to a PVC and emits a summary to a service at http://audit-portal:8080/api/v1/audit. Include an InitContainer to install jq, a ConfigMap with the audit script, a Secret for API creds, a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint, and describe how you'd verify and rollback?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace secret-rotation agent that runs as a Deployment in every namespace. It polls a central rotation API every 5 minutes for TLS certs, using a Token from a Secret, writes the certificate into a Secret named app-tls, updates a ConfigMap with lastRotation, and triggers a rolling restart of dependent Deployments. Logs go to a PVC at /logs; InitContainer installs curl; include readiness/liveness probes; a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricts egress to the rotation API. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In a CKAD scenario, you need to isolate a payment microservice from other pods while allowing only approved traffic within namespace 'finance'. The Deployment 'payment' has 3 replicas. Write a NetworkPolicy that (a) allows Ingress to payment only from pods labeled app=frontend in the same namespace, (b) allows Egress from payment only to pods labeled app=db on port 5432 and to pods labeled app=cache on port 6379. Provide the minimal policy manifest and describe how to validate under load?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace metrics-aggregator: a Deployment in each namespace queries metrics.k8s.io for Pods in that namespace, batches CPU/memory by app label over a WINDOW from metrics-config, and POSTs a digest to https://metrics-portal/api/v1/ingest using a Bearer token from metrics-portal-secret. Logs go to /logs PVC. InitContainer installs curl/jq; add probes; NetworkPolicy restricts egress to the portal. Provide a skeleton YAML and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, implement a per-namespace TLS secret rotation harness: a Deployment inside each namespace scans Secrets of type kubernetes.io/tls, checks expiry, and renews those expiring within a configurable window using an internal CA API. Use an InitContainer to install curl/jq; logs go to a PVC at /logs; update Secrets atomically to minimize downtime. Add readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the CA endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, implement a per-namespace scheduled migration job: a CronJob in each target namespace that runs hourly to migrate ConfigMaps by renaming keys from old-prefix to new-prefix, based on a migration plan stored in a namespace ConfigMap. Use an InitContainer to install yq, read the plan, update all relevant ConfigMaps, and write per-run logs to a PVC at /logs. Post a summary to http://migration-portal:8080/api/v1/migrate using a Secret for API tokens. Include readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the portal. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace analytics, implement a CronJob named data-migrate that runs hourly to read YAML manifests from a PVC mounted at /manifests, convert them to JSON written to /out, and use a Secret for credentials. Include an InitContainer to install yq/jq, a ConfigMap mounted at /config for options, concurrencyPolicy: Forbid, backoffLimit: 3, successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3, readiness/liveness probes for the pod, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to internal endpoints. Provide a minimal manifest sketch and a brief rollback strategy?

In namespace ci, a CronJob 'image-build' uses Kaniko to build from /workspace/Dockerfile on a PVC and push to registry.local/ci. Patch the CronJob to mount a ConfigMap at /workspace/config, add a checksum/config/workspace-config annotation to trigger rollouts on config changes, set resource requests/limits, add readinessProbe on /healthz and livenessProbe on /healthz, a preStop sleep 5s, and a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 2 healthy pods. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and verification steps?

In namespace log, implement a per-namespace log-sanitizer: a Deployment 'log-sanitizer' with 2 replicas reading raw JSON logs from PVC '/logs/raw' (log-pvc) and writing sanitized logs to '/logs/processed'. ConfigMap 'sanitizer-config' lists keys to strip (password, token). Use an InitContainer to install jq and a Python sanitizer script; a sidecar 'shipper' tails '/logs/processed' and POSTs to http://log-portal:9200/api/v1/logs. Include readiness /ready, liveness /live, resource requests/limits, preStop sleep, and a PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable: 1. Provide a minimal manifest patch and verification steps?

In CKAD terms, implement a per-namespace health-checker: a Deployment that reads HEALTH_ENDPOINT and INTERVAL from a ConfigMap, a token from a Secret, runs a loop hitting the endpoint every INTERVAL seconds, and POSTs a summary to a central endpoint; include InitContainer to install curl, a TLS sidecar for cert rotation, readiness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace Kubernetes CronJob in CKAD terms that runs every 10 minutes and pings a TARGET_URL from a ConfigMap, using an API_TOKEN from a Secret to authenticate, posting a heartbeat payload with a timestamp. Persist the last status in a namespace ConfigMap heartbeat-status and write run logs to a PVC at /logs. Use an InitContainer to install curl, mount the logs volume, add readiness/liveness probes on the Job's Pod, and provide a minimal YAML skeleton. What trade-offs exist?

In CKAD terms, implement per-namespace resource governance: create a Namespace-scoped ResourceQuota named 'team-quota' capping total CPU to 4, memory to 8Gi, and a LimitRange 'team-limit' enforcing min/max pod resources. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton for Namespace, ResourceQuota, LimitRange, and a Deployment that would respect or exceed quotas to test behavior. Include a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to internal endpoints. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, implement a per-namespace database-migration runner: a CronJob in a target namespace runs every 12 minutes to apply migrations against a Postgres instance. It uses DB credentials from a Secret and a connection endpoint from a ConfigMap, runs migrations from a ConfigMap mounted as /migrations, and logs to a PVC at /logs. Use an InitContainer to install psql and place it in /tools; readiness/liveness probes; a Namespace NetworkPolicy to restrict egress to the Postgres endpoint; store last run timestamp in a namespace ConfigMap migration-status. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace policy-enforcer agent: a Deployment in each namespace watches ResourceQuota and LimitRange changes, validates them against a policy ConfigMap (max CPU/mem, allowed quota types), and posts violations to a central endpoint via a Bearer token from a Secret. Logs go to a PVC mounted at /logs; InitContainer installs curl/jq; include readiness/liveness probes; Namespace NetworkPolicy restricts egress to policy-portal. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace 'config-aggregator' Deployment in namespace analytics that reads JSON events from a PVC mounted at /data/events, enriches each event by calling a REST endpoint, and writes enriched events to a separate PVC at /data/enriched. Provide a minimal manifest skeleton including InitContainer to install jq and curl, a ConfigMap for batchSize and endpoint, a Secret for API creds, a TLS sidecar for cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the enrichment endpoint and enriched storage. How would you validate under load and rollback?

In namespace nightly-backups, implement a CronJob named data-archiver with schedule 0 2 * * * that mounts data-pvc:/data and backups-pvc:/backups. Use an InitContainer to install pigz. A script must read DAYS_OLDER from ConfigMap backup-config (default 7), tar.gz dirs under /data older than the threshold into /backups/backup-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz, then POST a summary to http://backup-portal:8080/api/v1/backup-summary. Include resources, backoffLimit=3, successfulJobsHistoryLimit=3, readiness and liveness probes, and a PodDisruptionBudget. Explain verification and rollback steps?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-signing validator. A Deployment named image-signer runs in a namespace and watches a PVC-mounted /manifests directory containing Pod YAMLs with container image references. It validates each image signature using cosign, in an InitContainer that installs cosign, batching results according to BATCH_SIZE from signer-config ConfigMap, and POSTs a summary to http://signing-portal:7000/api/v1/summary. Include a Secret for API creds, a TLS rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace metrics-forwarder: a Deployment tails /metrics.log from a PVC, aggregates metrics in 1-minute windows, and forwards to an internal Prometheus Pushgateway at prom-gateway:9091. Use a ConfigMap to set BATCH_WINDOW_SECONDS, a Secret for credentials, an InitContainer to install curl and jq, and a sidecar for TLS cert rotation. Include readiness probes, resource requests, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the pushgateway. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-pull-policy enforcer: a Deployment runs a controller in the target namespace that scans Deployments for imagePullPolicy != Always, patches to Always, and triggers a rolling update by annotating the Deployment; logs to a PVC /logs; InitContainer installs kubectl; ConfigMap drives behavior, Secret supplies webhook creds to POST a summary; include readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress?

In namespace analytics, implement a CronJob named data-pruner that hourly creates a Job to prune /data/dumps in a PVC. PRUNE_DAYS comes from prune-config ConfigMap. The Job uses Alpine, with an InitContainer to stage /scripts/prune.sh from the ConfigMap. Include TTLAfterFinished: 86400, readinessProbe and livenessProbe on /healthz, and resource requests/limits. Use a minimal RBAC ServiceAccount; a Namespace NetworkPolicy allowing egress only to internal-api.analytics.svc.cluster.local:443. Verify under load by aging files and rollback by deleting the CronJob?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace cross-config-syncer: a Deployment in each app namespace mirrors shared-config from the config-plane namespace into a local app-config ConfigMap. A watcher loop polls every 30s via the Kubernetes API to apply deltas, with a ClusterRoleBinding granting access to ConfigMaps in the source namespace. Logs go to a PVC at /logs; a CronJob posts a heartbeat to central endpoint. Include minimal YAML skeletons and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace GitOps runner: a Deployment in each namespace watches a ConfigMap named gitops-config containing repo URL and a target path; an InitContainer installs git and tooling, then clones the repo into an emptyDir, runs kubeval and yamllint, and applies manifests with kubectl apply -f. Status is written to a per-namespace ConfigMap gitops-status and logs go to a PVC at /logs. Include a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace CronJob-based worker that watches a PVC-backed /data directory for new CSV files, processes them in batches (configurable via a ConfigMap named app-config with BATCH_SIZE), converts to JSON, and POSTS to a cluster-internal endpoint at http://data-portal:8080/api/v1/ingest. Use an InitContainer to install csvkit, a Secret for API credentials, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, a Namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint, and a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace CKAD microservice that exposes a REST endpoint and supports dynamic feature flags controlled by a ConfigMap. The ConfigMap contains JSON features; a Secret stores per-namespace API keys. Include an InitContainer to install runtime dependencies, a sidecar that watches the ConfigMap for changes and signals the main container to reload config, readiness/liveness probes, an HPA based on 95th percentile latency, and a PVC-backed log store. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace analytics, Deployment 'reporter' with 4 replicas is failing to fetch tokens because a restrictive NetworkPolicy blocks egress to api.analytics.internal:443. Provide a minimal patch to allow egress to that endpoint, preserving other rules, and describe how you would verify connectivity under load and rollback if needed?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that runs a small REST API (example Flask app) with config from a ConfigMap named app-config and an API key from Secret named api-credentials. Include an InitContainer to install dependencies, a sidecar to rotate TLS certs from a Secret named tls-certs, readiness/liveness probes, a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to DEST_ENDPOINT, and a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace log-forwarder in CKAD terms: a Deployment that tails logs from a PVC-mounted /logs directory produced by apps in the namespace, aggregates log counts by severity for the last minute, and POSTs a heartbeat payload plus the count to a REST endpoint defined in a per-namespace ConfigMap ENDPOINT using API_TOKEN from a Secret. On failure, write payloads to a DLQ directory in the same PVC. Include an InitContainer to install curl and jq, readiness/liveness probes, and a minimal YAML skeleton; discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that serves a static landing page with Nginx. The site content lives in a PVC mounted at /usr/share/nginx/html. Use a ConfigMap named site-config with SITE_TITLE and FOOTER, and a Secret named site-auth for htpasswd-based basic authentication. Include an InitContainer to pre-populate index.html from /config data, a readiness/liveness probe for /. Provide a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to an internal CDN at 10.0.0.0/16:443. Include a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that serves a tiny REST API (Flask) backed by a local SQLite DB stored on a PVC. Use a ConfigMap app-config to toggle ENABLE_FEATURE and set API_TIMEOUT, and a Secret api-credentials for basic-auth. Include an InitContainer to install deps, a TLS cert rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a NamespaceNetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal auth-service host. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that handles file-based ingestion from a PVC mounted /input: it should validate each JSON file against a schema stored in a ConfigMap named schema-config, normalize valid records to a consistent JSON, and POST them to http://data-portal:8080/api/v1/ingest using a Bearer token sourced from a Secret named api-tokens. Include an InitContainer to install jq and a validator, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint, and a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In namespace data, create a CronJob named daily-analytics that runs at 02:00 daily using image analytics-runner:2.0. It must mount a ConfigMap analytics-config (DB_HOST, DB_NAME, QUERY_TIMEOUT) and a Secret analytics-creds (DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD). Enforce no overlaps (concurrencyPolicy: Forbid), backoffLimit: 3, TTLSecondsAfterFinished: 86400, successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3, and annotate the PodTemplate with a checksum/config to reload on changes. How would you verify this under simulated load and when the config changes?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace log-collector Deployment that mounts /logs from a PVC, tails app.log for ERROR lines, batches them (configurable via a ConfigMap named app-config with BATCH_SIZE), and POSTs JSON payloads to an internal endpoint at http://analytics.local:9000/ingest using credentials from a Secret named api-credentials. Use an InitContainer to install a minimal Python runtime + requests, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that exposes a tiny HTTP API to store and retrieve JSON blobs using a PVC-backed path. Endpoints: POST /store with {id, blob}, GET /store/{id}. Use a ConfigMap named app-config with MAX_BLOB_SIZE, and a Secret named api-credentials. Include an InitContainer to install a minimal store tool, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to an internal auth service. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In a CKAD scenario, in namespace dataops, create a CronJob named db-backup that runs daily at 02:00 UTC to back up a PostgreSQL database. Use a ConfigMap backup-config for BACKUP_DIR and DB_HOST and a Secret db-credentials for DB_USER and DB_PASSWORD. Mount PVC backup-pvc at /backups and write backups as /backups/<dbname>-YYYYMMDD.sql. Enforce concurrencyPolicy: Forbid, keep 7 successful jobs, and set activeDeadlineSeconds: 7200. Provide manifests and a straightforward validation and rollback plan?

In CKAD terms, implement a per-namespace BackupPlan pattern (CRD) that triggers backups of a StatefulSet's PVC to a per-namespace S3-like bucket. Define CRD fields for targetStatefulSet, sourcePVC, destBucket, destPrefix; show a minimal Job-based workflow with an InitContainer to install awscli, a Secret for AWS creds, a ConfigMap for BUCKET/PREFIX, and a PVC for logs. Include readiness/liveness probes and a minimal YAML skeleton; discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace synthetic-traffic generator Deployment in CKAD terms: it reads TARGET_URL, PAYLOAD, and HEADERS from a Namespace ConfigMap, and a TOKEN from a Secret; an InitContainer installs curl. It should generate requests at a configurable rate, log each attempt to a PVC at /logs, and on failure move the payload to a DLQ on the same PVC. Include readiness/liveness probes and a CPU-based HPA; provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace prod, the 4-replica Deployment 'payments-api' must talk to an upstream processor at payments.proc.svc:443 using mTLS. Create minimal Kubernetes manifests to mount a Secret tls-secret containing client cert/key and CA, configure the container to use those certs, and restrict egress to only that endpoint via a NetworkPolicy. Show the patches and explain how you'd verify TLS and cert rotation?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Job that migrates data from a PVC /data/migrate by reading CSVs with csvkit (InitContainer installs tools), sending batched JSON to http://data-portal:8080/api/v1/migrate. Configure MIG_BATCH_SIZE in mig-config ConfigMap and API token in mig-creds Secret. Use a PVC-stored marker for idempotence, set backoffLimit, and add readiness/liveness probes. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that runs a rate-limited API proxy inside the cluster. It should read its rate limit from a ConfigMap named app-config, authenticate upstream calls with a Secret named api-credentials, and initialize dependencies in an InitContainer. Include a TLS cert-rotation sidecar using a Secret named tls-certs, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to upstream.internal:8080. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace 'prod', a Deployment named 'image-processor' with 4 replicas experiences spikes under load. Propose and implement a minimal patch to: (a) add resource requests/limits and health probes; (b) configure an HPA targeting 75% CPU (min 3, max 10 replicas); (c) add a PodDisruptionBudget to keep at least 3 healthy pods; (d) tune rolling updates (maxUnavailable:1). Then describe how you'd validate under simulated load and rollback if needed?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that serves a static site via nginx. Use a PVC-backed volume mounted at /usr/share/nginx/html, an InitContainer to fetch assets from an internal artifact registry based on a ConfigMap site-config (INDEX_FILE, THEME), and a Secret site-basic-auth for HTTP basic auth. Include readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy that restricts egress to the asset registry and internal DNS. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace prod, Deployment payments-api with 4 replicas uses a vendor-base image that runs as root. Provide a minimal patch to enforce a strict security posture: container securityContext (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 1000, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities: drop: ['ALL']); PodSecurityContext (fsGroup: 2000); and include imagePullSecrets if the registry is private. Explain how you would validate under load and rollback if issues arise?

In namespace payments, Deployment 'invoice-processor' (3 replicas) uses a ConfigMap and Secret to call an external invoicing API. A rolling upgrade to invoice-processor:2.1 fails health checks under load due to slow startup. Provide a minimal patch to: (1) add a startupProbe and adjust the readinessProbe, (2) add an initContainer to pre-warm a local cache from the ConfigMap, (3) add a PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable: 2. Explain verification under load and rollback steps?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace caching API deployment that exposes a small REST service on port 8080 and serves cached responses to other pods. It reads CACHE_SIZE and TIMEOUT from a ConfigMap named service-config, and a backend API key from Secret named backend-credentials. Include InitContainer to install dependencies, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to backend.svc.cluster.local:8443. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace CKAD-ready Deployment that acts as a synthetic feature-flag tester: it reads a list of feature endpoints from a Namespace ConfigMap named feature-endpoints, and an API_TOKEN from a Secret. InitContainer installs httpie. The Pod pings each endpoint at a configurable interval, writes per-endpoint results to /logs on a PVC, and updates a last-run summary in feat-test-status ConfigMap. Expose /metrics with per-feature latency; include readiness/liveness probes and a CPU-based HPA. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace inventory, a Deployment stock-service with 3 replicas mounts an emptyDir at /data and relies on a ConfigMap stock-config and a Secret db-credentials. Implement an InitContainer that waits for a Postgres DB at postgresql.inventory.svc:5432 and seeds data from /seed/init.sql (mounted from a ConfigMap). Ensure InitContainer runs before the app, add readiness and liveness probes for /health, and provide a minimal manifest patch plus the steps to validate under load and rollback?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace prod, a Deployment 'payments' with 3 replicas needs to talk to an external TLS endpoint using a Secret tls-secret (tls.crt, tls.key). Patch the Deployment to mount the secret as files at /tls, set TLS_CERT_FILE and TLS_KEY_FILE env vars, and add a readiness probe for /healthz. Provide a minimal manifest patch and verification approach?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace observability, a Deployment collector with 3 replicas throttles CPU under load. Provide a minimal patch to enable autoscaling and safe upgrades: (1) patch the Deployment with resource requests/limits and health probes; (2) add an HPA for min 2, max 6 with targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 60; (3) add a PodDisruptionBudget to keep at least 2 healthy pods during maintenance. Include patches and describe validation under load?

Design a per-namespace canary-traffic tester that coordinates a controlled canary rollout for a single Deployment within the namespace. The test reads CANARY_TARGET_APP, CANARY_VERS, and TARGET_SVC from a Namespace ConfigMap and API_TOKEN from a Secret; an InitContainer installs a lightweight CLI (curl/hey). It should shift 5% of traffic every 2 minutes by updating a ConfigMap entry that tracks canary percentage, logs per-request latency to a PVC at /logs, and stops on full rollout or rollback. Include readiness/liveness probes, a CPU-based HPA, and provide a minimal YAML skeleton; discuss trade-offs?

CKAD intermediate: In namespace ckad, Deployment api-server with 3 replicas uses a seed workflow to populate a per-pod cache on first boot. Implement a minimal InitContainer that executes a seed script from a ConfigMap, uses an PVC-backed /cache to ensure idempotence, and creates a marker file to skip reseed on subsequent restarts. Add readiness and liveness probes for /healthz, and describe how you would verify under load and rollback if needed?

In namespace data-ingest, a Deployment 'processor' with 2 replicas consumes daily CSV feeds from a mounted ConfigMap and writes to a PVC. Provide a minimal manifest patch to: mount the ConfigMap at /etc/processor, add a checksum/config annotation on the Pod template to trigger rolling restarts when the ConfigMap changes, set resource requests/limits, add readinessProbe on /livez and livenessProbe on /readyz, add a preStop sleep of 10s, and create a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 1 healthy pod during maintenance. Include how you'd verify under load and rollback?

Design a per-namespace backup CronJob that snapshots all PVCs using VolumeSnapshot, with Schedule from Namespace ConfigMap BACKUP_SCHEDULE, SnapshotClass from config, API_TOKEN from Secret to POST metadata to a REST endpoint, and LAST_BACKUP_STATUS written to a Namespace ConfigMap. Logs stored on a PVC. InitContainer installs kubectl and snapshotter CLI; include readiness/liveness probes and a minimal YAML skeleton; discuss trade-offs?

In namespace secure-app, a Deployment 'portal' runs nginx:1.25 as 2 replicas and must comply with a non-root security policy. Provide a minimal manifest patch to: run the container as a non-root user, drop all capabilities, enable readOnlyRootFilesystem, add a readinessProbe on /healthz and a livenessProbe on /healthz, and ensure zero-downtime upgrades with a rollingUpdate strategy. Include how you'd verify under load and rollback?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that runs a small data-collector UI/service. It reads ENDPOINT and MODE from a ConfigMap named app-config, uses a Secret api-credentials for basic auth, and mounts a PVC at /data. An InitContainer installs dependencies; a Sidecar rotates TLS certs from a Secret named tls-certs; include readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint at data-portal:8443. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that runs a tiny Python API exposing /health and /metrics. It reads config from a ConfigMap named app-config (ENABLE_METRICS) and a Secret named api-credentials. Include an InitContainer to install dependencies, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a NamespaceNetworkPolicy restricting egress to the upstream metrics service at metrics.internal.svc:9000. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace CronJob nightly validates CSV data stored in a PVC mounted at /data, using a ConfigMap app-config to supply SCHEMA_PATH and DATE_RANGE, a Secret qa-credentials to post results to the internal endpoint http://qa-portal:8090/api/v1/qa, an InitContainer to install pandas and jsonschema, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the QA endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace telemetry, a StatefulSet named 'collector' with 2 replicas uses a hostPath volume at /var/lib/collector and mounts /etc/collector from a ConfigMap. Provide a minimal manifest patch to: (1) switch the storage to a PVC backed by StorageClass 'fast-ssd' mounted at /var/lib/collector, (2) mount the ConfigMap at /etc/collector with checksum/config annotation to trigger rolling restarts when the ConfigMap changes, (3) set resource requests/limits, (4) add a readinessProbe on /healthz and a livenessProbe on /livez, (5) run as non-root user 1000:1000, (6) create a PodDisruptionBudget to ensure at least 1 pod is available during disruptions. Include how you'd verify under load and rollback?

In namespace analytics, a Deployment 'cache-writer' with 3 replicas uses a PVC for write-ahead logs and relies on a ConfigMap mounted at /config to initialize a cache. Provide a minimal manifest patch to add an InitContainer that copies /config/cache-base to /var/cache on first pod start, mount the ConfigMap at /config, and set a rollingUpdate strategy (maxUnavailable: 0), plus a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 2 healthy pods. Include how you'd validate under load and rollback?

In namespace secure, Deployment 'api-gateway' with 3 replicas mounts /srv from a PVC and reads config from a ConfigMap mounted at /etc/app. It currently runs as root. Provide a minimal manifest patch to harden security: set container securityContext (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 10001, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: drop: ["ALL"]), set PodSecurityContext (fsGroup: 1001), and add a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 2 healthy pods during maintenance. Include how you'd verify under load and rollback?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace Deployment that watches a PVC-mounted /data for new JSON files, validates them against a JSON Schema provided in a ConfigMap named app-schema, and exposes a GET endpoint /count returning the number of valid files. Use an InitContainer to install jq and ajv-cli, a Secret for an API_KEY, a sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a minimal YAML skeleton; discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace manifest-validation service: a Deployment that watches a PVC-mounted /manifests directory for YAML files, validates them using kubeval and yamllint, batches results according to BATCH_SIZE from a ConfigMap named validation-config, and POSTs a summary to http://validation-portal:8080/api/v1/validate. Include an InitContainer to install kubeval/yamllint, a Secret for API credentials, a Sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace canary controller in CKAD terms: a Deployment runs a reconciliation loop every 30s, reads a ConfigMap named canary-config in the same Namespace containing a JSON array [{name, replicas, canary}], and patches each target Deployment's replicas to the canary fraction. Persist last weights in canary-status ConfigMap. InitContainer installs jq, logs to /logs on a PVC, with readiness/liveness probes. Namespace NetworkPolicy allows egress only to kube-api:443. Include a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace edge, a Deployment 'edge-processor' with 3 replicas must be security-hardened. Provide a minimal manifest patch to enforce pod/container securityContext (runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, drop ALL capabilities, noPrivilegeEscalation), add a Namespace LimitRange and a ResourceQuota to bound resources, and describe verification steps under load and rollback?

CKAD advanced: design a per-namespace image-signature guard using a ValidatingWebhookConfiguration. In namespaces labeled guard=true, require all container images to be Cosign-signed with a public key stored in a ConfigMap. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton: Guard Deployment (InitContainer installs cosign), a ConfigMap with the key, a Secret for registry creds, a Service and ValidatingWebhookConfiguration, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy to restrict webhook traffic. Include trade-offs?

Design a CKAD per-namespace log-forwarder that tails a PVC-mounted /logs directory, batches lines using BATCH_SIZE from a ConfigMap named log-config, and POSTs to https://log-portal:9200/api/v1/logs. Include an InitContainer to install curl/jq, a Secret for API credentials, a TLS cert-rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace debug, a Deployment 'app' with 2 replicas needs on-demand debugging via EphemeralContainers. Provide a minimal manifest patch that adds an EphemeralContainer named 'debug-shell' (image busybox:1.36, command ['sh'], tty: true, stdin: true) to spec.template.spec.ephemeralContainers with resource limits; include a rollout-trace annotation on the Pod template to track the patch. Explain how to attach to the shell, how to rollback by removing the patch, and how you'd validate under load?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace cache-warming service: a Deployment that on startup preloads an external API into a namespace-scoped in‑memory cache. TTL, ENDPOINT, and KEY_LIST live in a ConfigMap; API_KEY from a Secret authenticates requests. Use an InitContainer to install curl/jq, a sidecar to rotate credentials, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the API host. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade‑offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace log-redaction service: a Deployment tails /logs from a PVC, redacts PII using patterns from a ConfigMap redaction-config, and writes sanitized logs back to the PVC. It POSTs a summary to http://logportal:8080/api/v1/sanitize. Include InitContainer to install sed/rg, a Secret for API credentials, a Sidecar for TLS rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace ephemeral-debug workflow: a CronJob that automatically attaches an ephemeral container to a running Pod labeled app=myservice in that namespace, executes diagnostics configured via a ConfigMap, and writes output to a PVC at /logs. Include InitContainer to install net-tools, a Secret for an upload endpoint, and provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss RBAC/security trade-offs?

In namespace payments, update Deployment 'processor' (2 replicas) that reads daily CSV feeds from a mounted PVC and writes to a separate PVC. Add a sidecar 'log-shipper' that tails /var/log/processor/app.log and ships to http://log-collector:10514/ingest using a shared emptyDir volume mounted at /var/log/processor and /var/log/ship. Also add an InitContainer to fix permissions on the logs directory mounted from the PVC. Include resource requests/limits, readinessProbe for /healthz, livenessProbe for /readyz, and a clear rollback plan. Provide a minimal manifest patch that accomplishes this?

In namespace prod, Deployment 'web' has 3 replicas. To debug a live pod under heavy load without rebuilding images, implement an Ephemeral Container approach. Provide a minimal manifest patch that adds an EphemeralContainer named 'trace' using image 'busybox:1.36', with command ['sh'], tty: true, and a volumeMount /debug mounted from an emptyDir volume 'trace'. Also add the corresponding volume. Outline how to attach to a running pod for debugging and how to rollback?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace security-audit Deployment that scans all pods in the namespace for privileged or root user usage, writes a JSON report to a PVC at /audits/report.json, and POSTs a summary to http://audit-portal:8080/api/v1/audit; include InitContainer to install jq, an audit-config ConfigMap for patterns, a Secret for API creds, a TLS-rotation sidecar, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the audit endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace baseline for resource governance: implement a Namespace containing a LimitRange that sets default CPU/memory requests and limits for pods, and a ResourceQuota that caps total CPU, memory, and pod count. Include a minimal Deployment manifest that uses these defaults. Provide minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace secret-rotation workflow: a CronJob in the target namespace runs every 15 minutes to fetch rotated credentials from a Vault-like API, updates the app-credentials Secret in that namespace, and streams run logs to a PVC mounted at /logs. Use an InitContainer to install curl and jq; include readiness/liveness probes for the Job's Pod, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the Vault endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace metrics-collector that tails a PVC-mounted /metrics, converts lines to Prometheus exposition format, and pushes to http://prometheus-pushgateway:9091/metrics/job/<namespace>. InitContainer installs awk/sed; ConfigMap sets METRIC_FORMAT and BATCH_INTERVAL; Secret holds Pushgateway creds; Sidecar rotates TLS certs; include readiness/liveness probes and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the Pushgateway. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In namespace secure, a Deployment 'api' with 2 replicas mounts a ConfigMap at /etc/api-config and a Secret at /etc/api-secret. Implement per-pod securityContext (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 10001, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true), drop ALL capabilities, set resource requests/limits, add a readinessProbe on /healthz and a livenessProbe on /readyz, include a preStop sleep 5s, and create a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 1 available during maintenance. Add a NetworkPolicy isolating the namespace but allowing egress to api.internal:443 and DNS, while denying all other egress. Provide a minimal manifest patch and describe how you'd verify under load and rollback?

Design a Kubernetes CKAD CronJob in the data-warehouse namespace that runs 3 parallel pods daily. Each pod mounts a PVC at /data/reconcile and a ConfigMap at /etc/reconcile; DB creds are provided via a Secret as env vars. Include resource requests/limits, terminationGracePeriodSeconds 30, and a checksum/config annotation on the Job template to re-run when the ConfigMap changes. Provide a minimal RBAC binding?

In namespace etl, design a 2-replica Deployment 'batcher' that reads YAML job specs from a ConfigMap-mounted directory /workloads, validates with kubeval in an InitContainer, generates and applies Job objects, and enforces a per-minute RATE_LIMIT from ConfigMap batch-config. Trigger rolling restarts on checksum/config annotation when specs change. Add resources, readinessProbe on /healthz, livenessProbe on /readyz, and a PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable: 1. Provide a minimal manifest patch and explain testing under load and rollback?

Design a per-namespace concurrent job orchestrator (CKAD): a Deployment per namespace with a worker and a sidecar that fetches batch-work from an external API using an API_TOKEN from a Secret, writes results to a per-namespace ConfigMap, and a CronJob to clean up old results. InitContainer installs curl; include readiness/liveness probes; a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the API. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace TLS certificate provisioning workflow: a CronJob in each namespace fetches short‑lived certs from a CA API using an API_TOKEN stored in a Secret, writes cert and key into a per-namespace Secret tls-cert-<svc>, and mounts them into the app via a Secret volume. Include a TLS‑reload sidecar to refresh on rotation and RBAC to permit Secret patching. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade‑offs?

In namespace frontend, implement a blue/green deployment behind a Service on port 80. Create two Deployments: web-blue and web-green with identical Pod specs; labels version=blue and version=green. The Service should route to version=blue by default. Provide a minimal manifest patch to switch traffic to green (via Service selector or Deployment label). Include readinessProbes, livenessProbes, and resource requests/limits. Describe load-test verification and rollback steps?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace event-driven rollout tester: a CronJob in each namespace reads a desired version from a ConfigMap, authenticates to an internal image registry with a Secret, and patches a target Deployment's image tag via a small script installed by an InitContainer. Logs go to a PVC at /logs; include readiness/liveness probes; apply a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting registry access. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

Design a per-namespace Event-Forwarder as a CronJob that reads a labelSelector from a ConfigMap, fetches cluster Warning/Error events using the Kubernetes Events API, writes logs to a PVC mounted at /logs, and posts a summary to a central webhook endpoint using an API_TOKEN from a Secret. The job must use an initContainer to install Python tooling, include readiness and liveness probes, and enforce egress restrictions via a Namespace NetworkPolicy. Include the complete YAML manifests.

In a Kubernetes CKAD scenario, you have a Deployment named 'web-app' in namespace 'prod' with 3 replicas; pods frequently OOMKilled under load. Describe a practical debugging plan and provide a minimal manifest patch showing resource requests/limits, a readiness probe, and a liveness probe. Include scaling considerations and how you'd validate the fix under load?

In a CKAD-focused cluster, namespace images has a Deployment 'puller' with 2 replicas that pulls tarballs from /tarballs on a PVC and pushes to registry.private.local; TLS certs from a Secret are required. Patch a minimal manifest to mount an internal CA at boot, auto-trust the CA, set hostAliases for registry host, ensure readiness and liveness probes, create a PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable: 1, and explain load-test and rollback steps?

In CKAD terms, design a beginner-friendly per-namespace nginx-based static-site deployment that serves content from a ConfigMap mounted at /usr/share/nginx/html. Provide (1) Deployment with 1 replica, resource requests/limits, readiness/liveness probes, and a ConfigMap hash annotation to re-roll on updates; (2) a Volume sourced from a ConfigMap named site-content; (3) a Namespace NetworkPolicy denying all egress except to a health-check service at health.local:8080; (4) a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In namespace backup, implement a CronJob db-backup that runs daily at 02:00 to back up /dump from a PVC to an S3 bucket. Provide a minimal CronJob manifest plus Secret s3-creds and ConfigMap backup-config (BUCKET, ENDPOINT). Use an InitContainer to install awscli; mount the PVC at /dump; access credentials via envFrom; run: aws s3 sync /dump s3://$BUCKET --endpoint-url $ENDPOINT. Explain testing and rollback steps?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace policy-enforcer that scans all Deployments in a namespace and flags any missing CPU/Memory requests or limits, optionally patching in defaults. Implement as a CronJob that consumes a PVC-mounted /policies/manifests and uses a script to compare each Deployment against defaults defined in the policy-config ConfigMap, posting a summary to http://policy-portal:8080/api/v1/enforce. Include InitContainer to install kubectl, a Secret for API creds, a sidecar for TLS cert rotation, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace config-reloader for a web app: a Deployment runs an app container and a sidecar watches a ConfigMap-backed /config directory for changes to runtime config. When a change is detected, update the app via a reload endpoint or graceful restart. Include an InitContainer to install inotify-tools, a Secret with API tokens to fetch remote defaults, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the internal service. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace image-scan guard for new pods: a Deployment in the target namespace runs an InitContainer that installs Trivy, scans the image of each new Pod on creation, writes scan results to a PVC, and updates a heartbeat ConfigMap in the namespace. Use a Secret for registry credentials and a ConfigMap for scan policy; enforce with a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to the vulnerability DB. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton and discuss trade-offs?

In namespace data-ingest, a Deployment 'ingest' with 2 replicas reads daily JSON lines from a PVC mounted at /data and writes to /output. Add a companion sidecar 'validator' that watches /data, validates each record against a JSON Schema provided by a ConfigMap mounted at /config/schema.json, and exposes metrics at /metrics on port 9000. Provide a minimal manifest patch to: mount the /config ConfigMap, trigger rolling restarts on config changes via checksum/config, set resource requests/limits, add readinessProbe on /healthz and livenessProbe on /readyz, a preStop sleep of 5s, and a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 1 healthy pod. Describe how you'd verify under load and rollback?

In namespace ml, deploy 'ai-processor' with 2 replicas that must run only on GPU-enabled nodes. Provide a minimal manifest patch showing: nodeSelector: hardware=gpu, tolerations for taint hardware=gpu:NoSchedule, resources: requests/limits including nvidia.com/gpu: 1, readinessProbe on /healthz, livenessProbe on /live, rollingUpdate with maxUnavailable: 1, and a 5s preStop. Explain verification under load and rollback strategy?

In namespace ingest, a Deployment 'collector' with 3 replicas mounts a ConfigMap at /config and uses a PVC. Provide a minimal manifest patch to: mount /config, add a checksum/config annotation on the Pod template to trigger rolling restarts when the ConfigMap changes, set resource requests/limits, add a readinessProbe on /healthz and a livenessProbe on /readyz, add a preStop sleep of 5s, and create a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 2 healthy pods during maintenance. Also add a HorizontalPodAutoscaler scaling on CPU to a min 2, max 6 replicas. Include verification steps under load and a rollback plan?

Design a per-namespace RBAC-audit Job (CKAD beginner). A Pod with a restricted ServiceAccount lists all ServiceAccounts, tests access with kubectl can-i for RESOURCES from ConfigMap rbac-config (pods, deployments, secrets, configmaps) and actions; writes report.json to a PVC; POSTs a summary to http://rbac-portal:8080/api/v1/report using a Secret token. InitContainer installs kubectl; Sidecar TLS rotation; probes; namespace NetworkPolicy. Minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace ephemeral-credential fetch workflow: a Deployment with an InitContainer that populates a token file by calling a Vault-like API and writes to a mounted /tokens/token.txt; the app reads and uses it for API calls. A CronJob refreshes the token every 6 hours and updates the Secret, which re-mounts for pods. Include RBAC, readiness/liveness probes, and a Namespace NetworkPolicy restricting egress to Vault and the API endpoint. Provide a minimal YAML skeleton. Discuss trade-offs?

In namespace migrate, implement a one-shot Job 'db-migrate' to apply SQL migrations stored in a ConfigMap mounted at /migrate/scripts, using credentials from a Secret 'db-creds'. The Job must install the PostgreSQL client via an InitContainer, run psql against host PGHOST, and exit with zero status. Configure ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 600, backoffLimit: 3, parallelism: 1, completions: 1, resource requests/limits, and test idempotence/rollback during validation?

In CKAD terms, design a per-namespace manifest-diff service that reads baseline.yaml and patch.yaml from a PVC, merges them with yq into final.yaml, validates final.yaml with kubeval and yamllint, and POSTs a digest to http://manifest-portal:8080/api/v1/diff. InitContainer installs yq/kubeval/yamllint; ConfigMap provides PATCH_STRATEGY and PATCH_INTERVAL; Secret stores API token; Sidecar handles TLS rotation; readiness/liveness probes; Namespace NetworkPolicy to allow only internal egress. Minimal YAML skeleton included; discuss trade-offs?

CKAD advanced: design a per-namespace test-runner that runs a CronJob in a namespace to validate that every Deployment has a readinessProbe and resource requests/limits; non-compliant items are annotated, and a remediation Job patches them. Maintain the top-k elements by value in a fixed-size sliding window of size W as a real-time stream arrives in batches of size B. Each batch adds B new items and, if needed, evicts oldest items to keep the window at W. After each batch, output the current top-k by value. Propose a practical data structure and amortized analysis that (i) supports batch inserts and evictions in O((B) log W), (ii) yields top-k queries in O(k) or O(log k), (iii) uses O(W) space, (iv) includes two optimizations, and (v) compares to rebuilding the top-k by scanning the window after every batch. Provide asymptotics in W,B,k?

You process a real-time stream of latency measurements: integers in [0, 100000], arriving in batches of B. After each batch, output an estimate of the 90th percentile. Propose a practical online approach using a fixed-bin histogram with K buckets. Explain how you map values to buckets, per-item updates, how you derive the percentile from the histogram, and memory/time complexities. Compare accuracy and cost to recomputing the percentile from all data and discuss when K is sufficient given workload?

Design a cache-aware dynamic hash map with incremental rehashing: two tables A and B, initial size 4. When load factor exceeds 0.5, rehash by moving a fixed number of buckets per operation while new inserts go to A. After N insertions and Q lookups, derive the amortized insertion cost, discuss the impact of a 1.5x growth factor on the bound, and explain cache implications of moving batches of buckets?

You have a rooted tree with n nodes (root = 1) and edge weights w(e). Dist(root, v) is the path sum. Process online batches of B updates, each setting w(parent(v), v) to a new value. After each batch, output the total sum of Dist(root, v) over all v. Propose an amortized data structure and analysis: preprocessing, per-edge cost, per-batch cost, memory, two optimizations, and a comparison to recomputing via a DFS after every batch?

Design a data structure to maintain S = sum_{i<j}|a[i]-a[j]| for an array a[1..n] with fixed n, under online batches of B updates (i -> v). After each batch output S. Propose a practical structure, preprocessing time, amortized update time, memory, two optimizations, and a comparison to rebuilding S from scratch after every batch. Include a concrete initial build and asymptotics?

Given a permutation of n distinct integers initialized as [1, 2, ..., n], you apply online batches of B adjacent swaps (swap positions i and i+1). After each batch, output the length of the Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS) of the current permutation. Propose a practical data structure to maintain LIS length under batched adjacent swaps, with (i) update time per batch, (ii) space, (iii) comparison to recomputing LIS from scratch after each batch, and (iv) concrete asymptotics in terms of n and B?

Design a batched data structure to maintain the exact 95th percentile of a growing multiset of positive integers, where each online batch of B values arrives; after each batch, output the current 95th percentile. Propose a practical approach that (i) handles batch inserts in O(B log n) time, (ii) answers the percentile in O(log n) or O(1), (iii) uses near-linear space, and (iv) includes two optimizations and a comparison to re-sorting after every batch?

In a DAG with N nodes and M edges and non-negative edge weights, edges are added only in batches of size B (no deletions). After each batch, determine whether any source-to-sink path has total weight at least W. Design a practical incremental longest-path data structure: (i) maintain a dynamic topological order, (ii) relax only when dist improves, (iii) expose O(1) query via dist array, (iv) use near-linear space, (v) include two optimizations, (vi) compare to recomputing from scratch per batch. Provide asymptotics in n, m, B, W?

Given an array a[1..n] with values in a large domain, process online batches of B point updates a[i] = v; after each batch, report the median of the multiset {a[1..n]}. Propose a practical data structure (e.g., an order-statistics tree) and an amortized analysis for updates and queries, including preprocessing time, memory, and a comparison to recomputing the median from scratch after every batch?

You maintain an undirected graph G=(V,E) representing a social network. Edges are added in online batches of size B (no deletions). After each batch you must output the exact k-core decomposition: the core number c(v) for all v. Propose a practical data structure and amortized update analysis that (i) preprocesses in O(n+m), (ii) updates in O(K) per batch where K is the number of vertices whose core number changes, (iii) uses near-linear space, and (iv) compares to recomputing the entire core decomposition from scratch after every batch. Include a concrete implementation plan and a small proof sketch?

Maintain a permutation a[1..n]. Online batches of B swap operations update pairs (i, j) swapping a[i] and a[j]. After each batch, output the total number of inversions in a. Propose a practical data structure that supports O(log n) local updates and O(1) batch queries, with preprocessing and memory bounds, and compare to recomputing inversions from scratch after every batch?

Dynamic batched MST maintenance: Given an undirected weighted graph with n nodes, edges arrive in batches of size B. After each batch, maintain a minimum spanning forest and answer whether two nodes x and y are connected, plus the current MSF total weight. Propose a practical approach using a dynamic tree structure, specify preprocessing, amortized per-batch update time, query times, two optimizations, and compare to rebuilding the MSF after every batch. Provide asymptotics in n, m, B?

You receive a real-time text stream of words from a fixed vocabulary of size M, arriving in batches of size B. After each batch, output the current top-k most frequent words seen so far. Propose an online algorithm using a hashmap for counts and a min-heap of size k to track the current top words. Provide update time per word, total time after t batches, memory usage, and compare to recomputing by scanning all seen words after each batch. Include asymptotics in M, B, and total elements processed?

You maintain an array a[1..n]. Updates arrive in online batches of B point assignments (i -> v). After each batch, report the k-th smallest value in a (k fixed). Propose a practical data structure and amortized analysis for updates and queries, including preprocessing time, memory, and a comparison to recomputing from scratch after every batch. Assume n up to 2e5, values 32-bit, k in [1,n]?

You manage a booking system with N reservations, each as an interval [L_i, R_i] on a 1D time axis. In online batches of size B, you receive updates that replace the endpoints of B intervals (i -> [L'_i, R'_i]). After applying the batch, report the maximum number of concurrent reservations at any time and a coordinate where this maximum occurs. Propose a practical data structure and amortized analysis, including preprocessing time, memory, and a comparison to recomputing from scratch after every batch. Provide asymptotics in N, M (distinct endpoints), B?

Propose a data structure to maintain top-K users by score in a social network with N users and online batches of B score updates (id, delta). After each batch, return the current top-K by score (tie-breaker by id). The DS should initialize in O(n), support amortized O(B log n) updates, and report top-K in about O(K log n). Include two optimizations and compare to rebuilding from scratch?

You receive a real-time stream of integers in [0, M-1], arriving in batches of size B. After each batch, output the current approximate mode (most frequent value seen so far) using bounded memory. Propose a Misra-Gries solution with k counters, detail per-element update, batch time, memory O(k), and error guarantees (at most N/k for frequency estimates). Compare to exact counting needing O(M) memory, with asymptotics in N and M?

You're building a real-time analytics pipeline that ingests numeric event values up to 1e9. Process events in online batches of size B and, after each batch, estimate the 95th percentile of all values seen so far with at most 1% relative error using O(k) memory. Propose a practical data structure and amortized update algorithm, including preprocessing, two optimizations, and a comparison to re-running from scratch?

In 2D, points arrive online in batches of size B with no deletions. After each batch, report the area and perimeter of the current convex hull. Design a practical incremental data structure that supports batch insertions efficiently, delivers amortized update time per batch, and uses near-linear space. Hull queries after each batch should be O(1). Include two optimizations and compare to rebuilding from scratch. Express asymptotics in n and B?

Maintain the convex hull of a 2D point set where points are added only in batches of B (no deletions). After each batch, report the number of hull vertices and the hull area. Propose a practical incremental hull maintenance structure that (i) preloads the existing hull, (ii) updates amortized per batch, (iii) provides O(1) queries for count and area, (iv) uses near-linear space, (v) includes two optimizations, and (vi) compares to rebuilding from scratch after every batch. Provide asymptotics in terms of n, B, h?

You maintain a categorical distribution of n items across m categories. You receive online batches of B updates where each update reassigns one item i from its current category to a new category. After each batch, output the entropy H = - sum_j (f_j/n) log(f_j/n). Propose a data structure and amortized analysis to support (i) O(1) preprocessing, (ii) O(B) updates per batch, (iii) O(1) entropy query, (iv) near-linear space, (v) two optimizations, and (vi) a comparison to recomputing H from scratch after every batch. Give asymptotics in n, m, B?

You receive a real-time stream of integers in [0, M-1], arriving in batches of size B. After each batch, output the approximate 95th percentile (P95) of all values seen so far. Propose an online quantile sketch (e.g., GK or KLL). State per-element update time, memory, and error guarantees (epsilon) for the percentile estimate, and compare to exact recomputation requiring O(N) memory. Provide asymptotics in epsilon, N, B?

You maintain a dynamic set of N intervals on the line. Intervals are added in online batches of size B; no deletions. After each batch, report the maximum number of overlapping intervals at any point. Propose a practical data structure using coordinate compression and a segment tree with range add and range max to update in O(B log M) and query in O(1) per batch; discuss preprocessing, memory, and compare to recomputing overlaps after every batch. Provide asymptotic bounds in N, B, and M?

Maintain a dynamic multiset of integers. You receive online batches of B numbers to insert (no deletions). After each batch output the median and the sum of absolute deviations to the median. Propose a two-tier data structure: a committed order-statistics tree for old data, plus a buffer for the new batch; describe how to bulk-merge and rebalance, and derive amortized per-element cost. Include memory bounds and two optimizations, and compare to inserting elements individually?

Maintain a dynamic set of closed intervals on the real line. Online batches of B updates arrive; each update is either add [l, r] or remove [l, r] (overlaps allowed; removals match previously added copies). After each batch, output the total length of the union of all intervals. Propose a practical data structure to support batch updates amortized, including preprocessing, memory bounds, two optimizations, and a comparison to rebuilding the union after every batch. Include asymptotics in n (current interval count), B, and coordinate range?

You receive a real-time stream of integers in [0, M-1], arriving in batches of size B. After each batch, output the median of all values seen so far. Propose a data structure (e.g., two heaps) to maintain the median with insertions in O(log n) and retrieval in O(1). State per-element update time, memory usage, and compare to recomputing the median from scratch after each batch. Include a small example?

Two real-time streams A and B of integers in [0, M-1], arriving in batches of size batchSize. After each batch, output the number of distinct values seen in both streams so far (intersection of value-sets). Propose a simple online data structure that maintains the intersection size with O(1) average per-element updates and O(1) retrieval, without storing all past values. Compare to recomputing from scratch and discuss memory vs accuracy?

Dynamic 2D point set with batched insertions: maintain points in [0,1e6]^2, receiving B new points per batch with no deletions. After each batch, answer Q offline rectangle-count queries reflecting all points up to that batch. Propose a practical data structure that (i) preprocesses once, (ii) handles batch updates amortized, (iii) answers each query in O(log^2 N) or better, (iv) uses near-linear space, (v) includes two optimizations, and (vi) compares to rebuilding a 2D range tree after every batch. Provide asymptotics in n, B, Q?

In a real-time analytics system, you process events in online batches of size B. Each event has a key (item_id) and a non-negative delta to its counter. After each batch, output the top-K items by their cumulative counts. Propose a data structure that (i) supports batch increments efficiently, (ii) returns the top-K in ~O(K log K) or better, (iii) uses near-linear space, (iv) amortizes per-batch updates, and (v) compares to re-scanning all items after every batch. Include preprocessing and a brief amortized analysis?

You maintain a dynamic multiset of integers in [1..U]. Each batch of B operations is insert(x) or delete(x). After each batch, estimate the number of distinct elements with relative error eps and 95% confidence, using minimal memory.
