You're given two arrays A[1..n] and B[1..n] of integers and an integer k. You may choose exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping intervals [l_j, r_j] with 1 ≤ l_j ≤ r_j ≤ n, such that r_j < l_{j+1}. The value of interval [l_j, r_j] is (sum_{i=l_j}^{r_j} A[i]) * (sum_{i=l_j}^{r_j} B[i]). Return the maximum total value and the list of intervals?

You're given a rooted tree with n nodes. Each node i has a value val[i]. You must select exactly k disjoint rooted subtrees (for a chosen root r, the subtree consists of r and all its descendants) such that no two selected subtrees overlap. Each chosen subtree contributes max(val[v]) over v in that subtree. Return the maximum possible sum of values from the k subtrees and provide a DP formulation to compute it, including the state definitions, transitions, base cases, and reconstruction?

Given a string s of length n consisting of lowercase letters and an integer k (0 <= k <= n). You may perform at most k edits, where one edit changes any character to any other lowercase letter. After edits, consider the longest palindromic subsequence (LPS) of the edited string. Your task is to maximize the LPS length by choosing edits, and return both the maximum LPS length and one exemplar palindromic subsequence that attains it. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t] representing the maximum LPS length in s[i..j] after at most t edits, including transitions and reconstruction?

You're given n jobs with processing times p[1..n], deadlines d[1..n], and profits w[1..n]. A single machine can process one job at a time non-preemptively. You may select a subset of jobs and schedule them starting at time 0, ensuring each scheduled job finishes by its deadline. What is the maximum total profit and a feasible schedule (start times and end times) for the chosen jobs? Provide a dynamic programming formulation with dp[i][t] as the best profit using the first i jobs and total time t, including recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Choose exactly k non-empty, non-adjacent subarrays to maximize the sum of (max(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r])) over all chosen subarrays. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Propose a DP formulation with precomputation of val(l,r) and a dp[i][t] transition that ends a subarray at i?

You're given an array A[1..n] of non-negative integers and an integer m with 1 ≤ m ≤ floor((n+1)/2). Choose exactly m elements so that no two chosen indices are adjacent. Each chosen A[i] adds to the total. Return the maximum sum and the indices chosen. Provide a DP formulation using dp[i][j] as the best sum for first i elements with j picks, include base cases, reconstruction strategy, and discuss time/space?

Given a string s of length n and an array delCost[1..n] representing the deletion cost of each character, delete exactly k characters so that the remaining string is a palindrome. Minimize total deletion cost. Return the minimum cost and the resulting palindrome. Propose a DP dp[i][j][d] representing the minimal cost for s[i..j] after deleting exactly d characters, with transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and integers k and c. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. For segment [l..r], its value is sum(A[l..r]) - c*(r-l). Return the maximum total value and the k endpoints. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the best value for the first i elements using t segments, include the recurrence, base cases, and a method to reconstruct the segments?

Given an array A[1..n] and an integer k, select exactly k non-empty, pairwise-disjoint contiguous subarrays (order preserved; subarrays may touch but not overlap). The total value is the sum of all chosen subarrays. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints (l_i, r_i) for i=1..k?

You're given an array arr[1..n]. You must pick exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays (windows). Each window's value equals the sum of its elements minus the maximum element within that window. Return the maximum total value and the list of window endpoints. Provide a DP formulation that runs in O(n^2 k) with reconstruction?

You're given a rooted tree with N nodes, each node i has weight w[i]. You must select exactly k node-disjoint simple paths (each path is a sequence of connected nodes) to maximize the sum of weights along all chosen paths. Return the maximum total weight and the node sequences for each path. Propose a DP formulation with states that capture whether the root of a subtree participates in an open path to its parent, and explain reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Select at most k non-empty, pairwise disjoint subarrays (contiguous blocks) to maximize the total sum of their elements. Subarrays may be adjacent and you must report the maximum sum and the endpoints of the chosen subarrays?

You're given an array A[1..n], integers d>=1 and k. You may form exactly k non-crossing, disjoint pairs (i-d, i) for i in [d+1..n]. Each pair contributes A[i-d] * A[i]. Pairs must be disjoint and non-crossing. Return the maximum total value and the list of pairs. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the best value using first i elements forming t pairs, include recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and integers k and c. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays. Each subarray yields sum(subarray) - c. Return the maximum total value and the list of chosen subarrays (start, end)?

You're given an n x m grid of integers G. You must find a path from (1,1) to (n,m) moving only right or down that uses at most K turns, maximizing the sum of visited cells. Return the maximum sum and the path as a sequence of coordinates. Provide a DP formulation with recurrences and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping subarrays that are separated by at least one element (i.e., if one ends at r, the next must start at l with l >= r+2). Each selected subarray's value is the sum of its elements. Return the maximum total sum and the endpoints of the selected subarrays?

Given an array A[1..n], you may select at most k non-overlapping subarrays. Each subarray contributes the sum of its elements. Return the maximum total and the boundaries of the chosen subarrays. How would you formulate a DP to compute this and reconstruct the solution?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays. Each subarray [l..r] yields value sum(A[l..r]) - c, with c a fixed per-subarray cost. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] and end[i][t], recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction?

You are given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping subarrays. Each subarray [l..r] contributes max(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best value using first i elements with t blocks, and show the transition using a candidate subarray ending at i. Include reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and a set D of allowed distances. Exactly k non-crossing, disjoint pairs (i, j) with i < j and j - i in D may be formed; each index used at most once. Pairs must be left-to-right (the right end of a pair is before the left end of the next). Each pair contributes A[i] + A[j]. Return the maximum total value and the list of pairs. Propose a DP recurrence with dp[i][t] as the best value using first i elements forming t pairs, include base cases and reconstruction?

You are given an n x m grid A of non-negative integers. You must route exactly k vertex-disjoint monotone paths from (1,1) to (n,m). Each step moves right or down. The value of a path is the sum of visited cell values; the total value is the sum across all k paths. Return the maximum total value and the actual k paths as coordinate lists. Constraints: n,m ≤ 100, k ≤ 10. Provide an algorithm and outline reconstruction?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] of non-negative integers. Pick exactly k indices, with no two chosen indices adjacent, to maximize the sum of chosen values. Return the maximum sum and the indices chosen. Propose a DP: dp[i][t] = max sum using first i elements with t picks; transitions: skip i -> dp[i-1][t], take i -> dp[i-2][t-1] + A[i]. Include base cases and a reconstruction strategy?

Given an array A[1..n] and an integer k, pick exactly k indices i1 < i2 < ... < ik such that no two chosen indices are adjacent (ij+1 - ij >= 2). Each chosen A[ij] contributes its value to the total. Return the maximum sum and the list of chosen indices. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best sum using first i elements with t selections, include transitions and reconstruction?

You have an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays. Each chosen subarray [l..r] contributes sum(A[l..r]) - c, where c is a fixed per-subarray penalty. Maximize the total value and return the endpoints of the k subarrays. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the best value for the first i elements using t subarrays, include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[0..n-1], and integers k, L, R. You must select exactly k non-overlapping contiguous subarrays such that each subarray's length is between L and R (inclusive). The sum of all elements in the selected subarrays is maximized. Return the maximum sum and the k subarrays (start and end indices). Provide a DP formulation with states, recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an n x m grid weights val[1..n][1..m]. Start at (1,1), end at (n,m), move only right or down. You must traverse a path with exactly K turns (direction changes). Return the maximum sum of visited cells and one corresponding path. Provide a DP formulation and reconstruction strategy?

You're given an array A[1..n] and integer k. Partition into exactly k non-empty contiguous segments that cover the whole array. Each segment's value is the minimum element within that segment. Return the maximum sum of the k minima and the segment boundaries. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = best sum for first i elements partitioned into t segments, include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given N tasks, each with start time s_i, end time e_i (s_i < e_i), and value v_i. You must select exactly K tasks that do not overlap (intervals must be disjoint). Return the maximum total value and the list of chosen tasks. Propose an DP solution running in O(n log n + nK) time by sorting tasks by end time, computing p[i] as the last non-overlapping task before i via binary search, and using dp[i][t] = max(dp[i-1][t], dp[p[i]][t-1] + v_i). Include base cases and reconstruction?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Choose exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping subarrays. The score of a subarray [l..r] is sum(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total score and the list of subarray endpoints (l, r). Propose a DP formulation: dp[i][t] = max_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + sum(A[p+1..i]) - min(A[p+1..i]). Base: dp[i][1] = sum(A[1..i]) - min(A[1..i]). Include reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

You're given a string s of length n (lowercase) and an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n). Partition s into exactly k non-empty palindromic substrings. Each substring contributes a score equal to the number of distinct characters it contains. Return the maximum total score and the cut positions that define the partitions. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] representing the best score for the first i chars using t palindromes, including reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays; each chosen subarray contributes sum(subarray) - p (p is fixed). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the subarrays. Propose a DP recurrence with dp[i][t][b] representing best value up to i with t completed subarrays and b indicating whether a subarray is open, and include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Choose exactly k non-empty, disjoint subarrays in order to maximize total value, where each subarray [l..r] contributes sum(A[l..r]) - c*(r-l+1), with c a fixed per-subarray cost. Return the max value and the boundaries of the chosen subarrays. Provide a DP formulation and reconstruction strategy?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. You may delete exactly k elements from the array such that no two deleted indices are adjacent. After deletions, the remaining elements preserve their order. Maximize the sum of the remaining elements. Return the max sum and the list of deleted indices?

You're given a directed weighted graph G=(V,E) with n nodes, a start node s, an end node t, and an integer k. You may walk exactly k edges (nodes may repeat). Each edge (u,v) has weight w. Return the maximum total weight on a walk from s to t using exactly k edges, and output the vertex sequence. Propose a DP with dp[v][i] as best weight to reach v in i steps, include recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction; discuss time/space?

Given an array A[1..n] and an integer k, partition the array into exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays. The value of a subarray [l..r] is sum(A[l..r]) * min(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the subarray boundaries?
Given A[1..n], integers k, L, U with 1 <= L <= U < n, pick exactly k indices i1<...<ik such that L <= i_{s+1}-i_s <= U for all s. Return the maximum sum of A[i_s] and the corresponding indices?

You're given a circular array A[0..n-1] of non-negative integers and an integer k (0 < k <= floor(n/2)). Choose exactly k indices with no two adjacent (circularly). Each chosen index i contributes A[i]. Return the maximum sum and the chosen indices. Propose a DP formulation to handle the circular constraint (split into two linear cases) and show reconstruction?

You're given a string s of length n and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping palindromic substrings. Each chosen substring contributes its length to the total value. Return the maximum total length and the list of substrings as (start, end) indices. Propose a DP with pal[l][r] precomputed and dp[i][t] = max value using prefix s[1..i] with t substrings; transitions: skip i or end a palindrome at i starting at l with value (i-l+1) plus dp[l-1][t-1]. Include reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may form exactly k non-overlapping, left-to-right subsequences. Each subsequence lies within a contiguous window and must be strictly increasing in both index and value. The value of a subsequence is the sum of its elements. Return the maximum total value and the actual subsequences (as index lists). How would you implement a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = max_{p<i} dp[p][t-1] + msis(p+1, i)?

You are given a rooted tree with N nodes, root = 1. Each node i has weight w[i]. You must select exactly K root-to-node paths that start at the root and terminate at some node in the tree. The paths must be vertex-disjoint except at the root. Each path's value is the sum of weights along that path. Return the maximum total value achievable and the endpoints of the K paths. Provide a DP formulation on the tree, specify dp[v][t] and how to combine children's contributions; include reconstruction?

You're given an array profits[1..n] and integers k and d (d>=1). You must schedule exactly k maintenance days on distinct days such that i_{j+1} - i_j > d. Each chosen day contributes profits[i]. Return the maximum total profit and the list of chosen days. Provide a DP formulation with transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping subarrays (a1..b1), (a2..b2), ..., (ak..bk) with 1 ≤ a1 ≤ b1 < a2 ≤ b2 < ... ≤ n. Each selected subarray contributes sum(A[a_i..b_i]) - c, where c is a fixed per-subarray cost. Return the maximum total value and the list of subarrays. Propose a DP recurrence with dp[i][t] as the best value considering first i elements forming t subarrays, include transitions and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Choose exactly k non-overlapping subarrays to maximize sum of subarrays minus a fixed cost c per subarray. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the chosen subarrays. Provide a DP formulation with transitions and reconstruction, and briefly discuss time/space trade-offs?

You're given an array A[1..n] and integers k and L. You must pick exactly k non-overlapping subsequences, each of length L (i1<...<iL), such that no index is used twice. Each subsequence's value is sum(A[i1],...,A[iL]). Return the maximum total value and the actual index lists for each subsequence?

You're given an n×m grid with integers A[i][j]. Start at (1,1) and end at (n,m) moving only right or down. You must use at most K turns (a turn is a change of direction). Return the maximum sum of visited cells and one path of coordinates?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may place exactly k non-overlapping dominoes on consecutive elements: a domino placed at i covers (i,i+1) and yields value A[i] + A[i+1]. Dominoes cannot overlap and must be left-to-right. Return the maximum total value and the list of domino start indices. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] = best value using first i elements to form t dominoes, include recurrence and reconstruction?

You're given a DAG with N nodes and M directed edges; each node v has value w[v]. You must select exactly k vertex-disjoint directed paths that start at a source (in-degree 0) and end at a sink (out-degree 0), maximizing the sum of weights of all visited nodes across all paths. Propose a DP in topological order using f[v][t] as the max total weight for t paths that end at v, plus how to reconstruct the paths?

You're given a string s of length n over lowercase letters and an integer k. You may delete exactly k characters from anywhere; after deletions, what is the maximum length of the Longest Palindromic Subsequence (LPS) of the remaining string, and which indices should be deleted? Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t] representing the LPS length in s[i..j] after deleting t characters from this interval, include recurrences and reconstruction?

You're given an n x m grid of non-negative integers grid[i][j], representing rewards for visiting cell (i,j). A path from (0,0) to (n-1,m-1) can move only right or down. You must collect rewards along the path. You may incur at most k turns (a turn is when you switch from moving right to down or vice versa). Return the maximum total reward and one optimal path as a sequence of coordinates?

You're given an array A[1..n], an integer k, and a fixed cost c. You may select at most k non-overlapping subarrays; each subarray contributes sum(A[l..r]) - c. Return the maximum total value and the list of endpoints (l, r) for the chosen subarrays. Provide a DP formulation and how you'd reconstruct the intervals?

You're given an m x n grid of integers grid[i][j]. You start at (0,0) and can move only right or down to (m-1,n-1). You have up to k vouchers that can be applied to any visited cell; applying a voucher on a cell doubles its value for that visit. How would you compute the maximum path sum and the path with voucher placements, using a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t], and how would you reconstruct the path and voucher usage?

You're given a rooted tree with N nodes, weights w[i]. You must select exactly k vertex-disjoint simple paths (paths may be a single node). The total value is the sum of weights of all vertices contained in the chosen paths. Return the maximum total and the list of paths as endpoint pairs. Provide a DP formulation with per-node states and reconstruction?

You're given a binary string s of length n and an integer k. In exactly k operations you may flip a contiguous, non-overlapping segment. Flipping inverts the bits. Maximize the number of '1's in the final string. Return the maximum number of '1's and the segments flipped. Propose a DP that maximizes the final ones with states for segment ends and reconstruction?

You're given A[1..n], an integer k, and a fixed per-segment cost c. You may select exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping subarrays. Each subarray contributes sum(A[l..r]) - c. Return the maximum total value and the list of chosen subarrays as [l, r] pairs. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] as the best value using the first i elements with t segments; include recurrences and reconstruction?

You're given an n x m grid of nonnegative integers and a parallel blocked[n][m] boolean grid. You start at (0,0) and end at (n-1,m-1), moving only right or down. You may unblock at most k blocked cells along your path; unblocked cells contribute their value to the sum. Blocked cells not unblocked cannot be traversed. Return the maximum path sum and one path. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t] for max sum to (i,j) using at most t unblocks, include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n], and integers k and c. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays (i1..j1), (i2..j2), ..., (ik..jk) with 1 ≤ i1 ≤ j1 < i2 ≤ j2 < ... ≤ n. Each subarray contributes sum(A[i..j]) - c. Return the maximum total value and the list of subarrays?

You are given an n x m grid grid with integers; start at (0,0) and end at (n-1,m-1). You may move only right or down. You must make exactly k turns (switch between right and down). Return the maximum sum of values along the path, including start and end, and the coordinates of the path. Provide a DP formulation using dp[i][j][t][dir] as the best sum to reach (i,j) with t turns and ending in dir (0=right,1=down), including transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an n x m grid of integers grid[i][j] and a boolean hotspot[i][j]. Start at (1,1), end at (n,m); you may move only right or down. You must visit exactly K hotspot cells along the path. Maximize the sum of values of the visited cells. Return the maximum sum and the path coordinates. Propose a DP with dp[i][j][t] as the best sum to reach (i,j) having visited t hotspots, include transitions and reconstruction?

Given two arrays A[1..n] and B[1..m] and integer k, you may form exactly k non-crossing, disjoint pairs (i, j) with i from A and j from B; indices strictly increasing in both sequences and each index used at most once. Each pair contributes A[i] * B[j]. Return the maximum total value and the list of pairs. Propose a DP with dp[i][j][t] as the best value using first i and first j elements to form t pairs; include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array nums[0..n-1] and an integer k. You may select up to k non-overlapping subarrays; the value of a subarray is its sum. Return the max total and the list of chosen subarrays as [start,end]. Propose a DP: dp[i][t] = max sum on first i elements with at most t subarrays; local[i][t] = best subarray ending at i-1. Transitions: local[i][t] = max(local[i-1][t] + nums[i-1], dp[i-1][t-1] + nums[i-1]); dp[i][t] = max(dp[i-1][t], local[i][t])?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays; each subarray contributes the sum of its elements. Return the maximum total sum and the k subarrays' (start, end) indices. Provide a DP formulation showing dp[i][t] = max sum using first i elements with exactly t subarrays, including transitions and a brief reconstruction strategy?

Given revenue[1..n] and a fixed cost c, select exactly k non-overlapping campaigns, each covering a contiguous window [l..r]. Profit of a campaign is sum revenue[l..r] - c. Return the maximum total profit and the selected windows?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] of non-negative integers. You must select exactly k non-overlapping subarrays. The value of a subarray A[l..r] is A[l] XOR A[l+1] XOR ... XOR A[r]. Return the maximum possible sum of the k subarray values and the list of chosen (l, r) pairs. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the maximum total value using the first i elements to form t subarrays; provide transitions, reconstruction method, and discuss time/space. Include a brief example?

Given A[1..n] and integers k and c, choose exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays. Each subarray [l..r] contributes sum(A[l..r]) if (r-l+1) is even, else sum(A[l..r]) - c. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k segments. Propose an O(nk) DP with dp[i][t] as the best value for first i elements forming t segments, include transitions and reconstruction?

You're analyzing a time-series A[1..n] of user activity per minute. You must label exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty windows (subarrays) to mark peak periods. The total value is the sum of A[i] over chosen windows. How would you formulate a DP with dp[i][t] = best value using first i elements with exactly t windows, including transitions and reconstruction, and what would be the time/space complexity?

You're given an array A[1..n] of non-negative integers and an integer k. You may select at most k non-overlapping contiguous subarrays. Each chosen subarray [l..r] yields a value equal to max(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value you can achieve and the endpoints of the chosen subarrays in order. Provide a dynamic programming formulation using dp[i][t] to denote the best value using the first i elements and t subarrays, include how you compute transitions and how you reconstruct the solution?

You are given revenue[1..n] and must partition into exactly k non-empty contiguous segments. The value of a segment [l..r] is (sum revenue[l..r])^2. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the segments. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the best value for the first i days partitioned into t segments, include the recurrence and reconstruction?

You are given a string s of length n and an integer k. You may choose exactly k non-overlapping substrings. Each chosen substring contributes the number of distinct characters in the substring. Return the maximum total sum and the list of substrings (start, end). Provide a DP formulation: dp[i][t] is the max total distincts using first i characters with t substrings; include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given n jobs with start[i], end[i], and value[i]. You may schedule at most k non-overlapping jobs (a job occupies [start[i], end[i]]). Return the maximum total value and the list of selected jobs. Provide a DP formulation with jobs sorted by end, let p(i) be the last job ending before start[i], and use dp[i][t] = max(dp[i-1][t], dp[p(i)][t-1] + value[i]); include reconstruction steps and discuss time/space?

You're given a 2D grid of integers grid[n][m]. Find a path from (0,0) to (n-1,m-1) moving only right or down that uses exactly t turns (direction changes). The path sum is the sum of visited cells. Return the maximum sum and the path coordinates. Propose a DP with dp[i][j][dir][k] = max sum reaching (i,j) with last move dir (0=right,1=down) after k turns, and specify transitions and reconstruction?

You're given a rooted tree with n nodes, each node i has a value val[i]. You must choose a connected subgraph containing exactly k nodes to maximize the sum of values. Return the maximum sum and one such set of nodes. Propose a DP: dp[u][s] = maximum sum of a connected subgraph of size s that lies within the subtree of u and includes u. Explain the recurrence and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A[1..n], an integer k, and a constant c. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous segments [l..r] anywhere in A; each segment contributes sum(A[l..r]) - c. Segments may be separated by gaps and do not need to cover the entire array. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the chosen segments. Provide a DP formulation and how you would reconstruct the segments?

Given an n x m grid of integers grid[i][j], start at (0,0) and move only right or down to (n-1,m-1). You must choose exactly k cells along the path to activate as boosts, each boost adds B to that cell’s value. Return the maximum total sum and the coordinates of boosted cells along the path?

You're given a rooted tree with n nodes, each node v has weight w[v]. Remove exactly k edges to form k+1 components. Each component's value is the maximum weight among its nodes. Return the maximum possible sum of component values and the list of edges to cut. What DP formulation would you use, and how would you reconstruct the edge cuts?

Two strings A and B with lengths n and m (n,m ≤ 2000) and an integer K. You may insert exactly K gaps total in the alignment; each gap costs G. Matching chars yield M, mismatches yield -N. Return the maximum alignment score and one optimal alignment, and provide a DP formulation using dp[i][j][t] for prefixes with exactly t gaps; include transitions, base cases, and reconstruction?

You're given a rooted tree with n nodes, node values a[v]. You may select at most k node-disjoint root-to-leaf paths. Each path's value is the sum of a[v] along that path. Return the maximum total value and the actual paths (as sequences of node IDs). Provide a DP formulation with dp[v][t] as the best value in the subtree of v using t paths?

You are given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays (non-empty). Each selected element incurs a fixed per-element penalty p, i.e., the value of a subarray [l..r] is sum_{i=l..r}(A[i]-p). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Provide a DP recurrence with dp[i][t] representing the max value using first i elements with t subarrays; include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given a string s of length n over letters 'a'–'z' and a 26x26 matrix W, where W[a][b] is the score for having a followed by b in the final kept sequence. You may delete at most k characters from s. The score is the sum of W[prev_kept][cur_kept] for each adjacent kept pair (no score for the first kept char). Return the maximum score and one valid set of deletions. Propose a DP formulation and reconstruction steps?

You're given an array A[1..n]. Choose exactly k indices i1<...<ik to minimize the sum of absolute differences between consecutive selected values: sum_{t=1}^{k-1} |A[i_{t+1}] - A[i_t]|. Return the minimum total variation and the chosen indices. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the minimum cost ending at i with t elements selected, include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer m (1 <= m <= n). You must select exactly m indices i1 < i2 < ... < im to form a subsequence. The cost is the sum over k=2..m of |A[ik] - A[ik-1]|. Return the minimum possible cost and the corresponding indices. Propose a DP formulation with states dp[i][t], recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space complexity and potential optimizations?

You're given an array A[1..n] and m candidate intervals [l_i, r_i] with value v_i = min(A[l_i..r_i]). You may select exactly k non-overlapping intervals, in left-to-right order, to maximize the sum of v_i. Return the maximum total value and the chosen intervals' indices. Propose a DP formulation with p(i) defined as the last interval that ends before l_i, and dp[i][t] representing the max value using first i intervals to pick t intervals. Include recurrence and reconstruction?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Find a non-contiguous subsequence of length exactly k that is non-decreasing (A[i1] <= A[i2] <= ... <= A[ik]), maximizing the sum of its elements. Return the maximum sum and the indices of the chosen elements. Propose a DP: dp[i][t] = max sum of a non-decreasing subsequence of length t ending at i. Recurrence: dp[i][1] = A[i]; dp[i][t] = A[i] + max_{j<i, A[j] <= A[i]} dp[j][t-1]. Include reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

Given array A[1..n], integers k and L, you may pick exactly k non-overlapping subarrays of length L. Each subarray contributes sum(A[i..i+L-1]). What is the maximum total value and the starting indices of the k subarrays?

You have an n x m grid of non-negative integers grid[i][j]. Start at (0,0) and end at (n-1,m-1). Move only right or down. Exactly k turns (direction changes) are allowed along the path. Return the maximum sum of visited cells. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t][d] where d is the last move (0 for right, 1 for down), include transitions and a reconstruction plan?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You may form exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays. Each subarray contributes max(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the boundaries of the chosen subarrays?

You're given an array A[1..n]. You may select exactly k elements with the constraint that any two chosen indices differ by at least d+1 (i.e., if i is chosen, no index in [i-d, i+d] can be chosen). Return the maximum sum and the list of chosen indices. Provide a DP recurrence and how to reconstruct the solution?

Given an n x m grid grid[i][j] of integers, you start at (0,0) and move to (n-1,m-1) by only right or down moves. You must visit exactly k turns (a turn is when your move direction changes from right to down or from down to right). Return the maximum possible sum of visited cells and one path achieving it. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t][dir] representing the max sum to (i,j) with t turns and ending in dir (0 for right, 1 for down); include transitions, base cases, and reconstruction details?

You're given a string s of length n and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping palindromic substrings of s. Substrings must be left-to-right with no overlap. Each chosen substring contributes its length to the score. Return the maximum total length and the list of substrings as (start, end) indices. Propose a DP with precomputation isPal[l][r], and dp[i][t] as the best total length using first i chars with t palindromes, including transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n], a window length w, and an integer k. Choose exactly k non-overlapping contiguous windows of length w. Each window contributes max(A[l..l+w-1]). Return the maximum total value and the starting indices of the chosen windows. Provide a DP formulation and reconstruction strategy?

Given A[0..n-1], integers k and c, choose exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays. Each subarray [l..r] yields sum(A[l..r]) - c. Return the maximum total value and the list of chosen intervals (endpoints)?

You're given a string s of digits, length n, and an integer k. Split s into exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping substrings that cover s, each substring must be a palindrome. Each substring is interpreted as a decimal integer (no leading zeros unless the substring is exactly '0'). Maximize the sum of the k numbers and return the boundaries of the substrings in addition to the maximum sum. Provide a DP recurrence and reconstruction plan?

You are given a rooted tree with N nodes. Each node v has weight w[v]. You must select exactly K node-disjoint simple paths located anywhere in the tree. The union of chosen paths must form a forest in which every connected component is a simple path (no branching). The score is the sum of weights of all nodes included in the paths. Return the maximum total weight and the list of paths as sequences of node IDs (endpoints to endpoints). Propose a bottom-up tree DP that computes dp[u][k][t], where k is the number of complete paths in the subtree of u and t ∈ {0,1,2} encodes whether u is unused (0), an endpoint that is closed inside the subtree (1), or an endpoint that can be extended to the parent (2). Include base cases, transitions over children, and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. You must choose exactly k indices i1< i2<...<ik; the score is sum_{p=1..k} A[ip] * p. Return the maximum score and the chosen indices. Provide a DP formulation with the recurrence dp[i][t] = max(dp[i-1][t], dp[i-1][t-1] + t*A[i]); include base cases and how to reconstruct the indices?

You're given an array A[1..n] of integers (positive or negative). You may select up to k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays. Each subarray contributes the sum of its elements. Return the maximum total sum and the endpoints of the chosen subarrays. Provide a DP recurrence that runs in O(nk) and explain how to reconstruct the chosen subarrays?

You're given n tasks, each with start time s[i], end time e[i] (s[i] < e[i]), and value w[i]. You can select at most k tasks such that no two selected tasks overlap in time. Return the maximum total value and the list of selected task indices. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the max value using the first i tasks (sorted by end time), including how to compute p[i] (the last task with e[p[i]] <= s[i]), and how to reconstruct the solution?

You are given a grid values of size R x C with non-negative integers. Starting at (1,1), reach (R,C) by moving only right or down. You may make at most K turns (direction changes). Return the maximum sum collected along the path and the path itself as coordinates. Provide a DP formulation using states dp[i][j][t][dir], transitions, base cases, and reconstruction?

Given an array A[1..n] and integers k and B, form exactly k non-crossing, disjoint pairs (i, j) with i < j, such that sum of (j - i) across all pairs ≤ B. Each index used at most once. Each pair contributes A[i] * A[j]. Return the maximum total value and the list of pairs?

You're given an array revenue[1..n] representing monthly revenue. You may select exactly k months to run promotions, with the restriction that two selected months cannot be consecutive. Each chosen month contributes revenue[i] - cost. Return the maximum total revenue and the list of selected month indices. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the best value using first i months forming t selections, include transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Choose exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping subarrays to maximize the sum of their elements. Return the maximum total and the boundaries [l1,r1],...,[lk,rk]. How would you formulate a DP with dp[i][t] representing the best total using the first i elements to form t blocks, including transitions and reconstruction?

You're given an array a[1..n] of positive integers and an integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ n). Choose exactly k indices such that no two chosen indices are adjacent. Return the maximum possible sum and the chosen indices. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] representing the max sum using first i elements and selecting t elements with no adjacent. Include the transitions, initialization, and a reconstruction method for the indices?

Given an array revenue of length n and an integer K, compute the maximum sum obtainable by selecting up to K non-overlapping subarrays; each subarray contributes the sum of its elements. Provide an O(nK) DP with O(K) space and discuss correctness and edge cases. Implement the function maxRevenue(A, K) and include a few small tests to validate?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer d. You may select a subsequence (not necessarily contiguous) such that for every pair of consecutive chosen elements A[i] and A[j] with i<j, |A[i]-A[j]| <= d. Maximize the sum of the chosen elements. Return the maximum sum and one valid subsequence of indices. Provide the DP formulation, reconstruction approach, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. The score of a subarray [l..r] is the sum of |A[i+1]-A[i]| for i in [l..r-1]. Return the maximum total score and the partition endpoints (end indices). Propose a DP: dp[i][t] = max_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + sum_{q=p+1}^{i-1} |A[q+1]-A[q]|. Base: dp[i][1] = sum_{q=1}^{i-1} |A[q+1]-A[q]|. Explain reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. Each subarray's score is the number of distinct elements within that subarray. Return the maximum total score across all partitions and the k subarrays' boundaries (start and end indices). Propose a DP formulation with states dp[i][t], recurrences, base cases, reconstruction, and discuss time/space complexity?

You are given an array A of length n and an integer m. You must select exactly m indices i1 < i2 < ... < im. The total cost is sum_{t=2..m} |A[i_t] - A[i_{t-1}]|. Return the minimum total cost and the indices. Propose a DP formulation with states dp[i][t] representing the minimum cost ending at i as the t-th picked element, base cases, recurrences, how to reconstruct the path, and discuss time/space complexity and possible optimizations?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. Each subarray's cost is the maximum element within that subarray. Return the minimum total cost and the partition endpoints. Propose a DP formulation with states dp[i][t] representing the minimum cost to partition the first i elements into t subarrays, with recurrence dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + max(A[p+1..i]). Base: dp[i][1] = max(A[1..i]). Describe reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

You are given a string s of length n over lowercase letters. You may delete characters to obtain a string that strictly alternates between two distinct characters, e.g., abab... or xyxy.... Choose any two distinct characters and delete all other characters. Return the maximum possible length and the pair (a,b) of characters used. Propose a DP to compute, for each ordered pair (a,b), the longest alternating subsequence using only a and b; include base cases, transitions, and how to reconstruct the solution?

You're given a DAG with n nodes and m directed edges. Each node i has value val[i]. For a fixed k, find a path with exactly k nodes maximizing the sum of values along the path. Return the max sum and the path as node indices. Provide a DP formulation with states, recurrences, base cases, reconstruction, and complexity notes?

You're given a string s of length n and an integer k (1 <= k <= n). Partition s into exactly k non-empty contiguous substrings. For each substring, define cost as the minimum number of character changes required to make that substring a palindrome (i.e., the number of mismatched symmetric pairs). Return the minimum total cost and the partition boundaries that achieve it. Propose a DP formulation with precomputed costs cost[l][r], state dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + cost[p+1][i], base dp[i][1] = cost[1][i]. Describe reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

You're given a string s of length n and an integer k. You may delete at most k characters from s. What is the maximum possible length of a palindromic subsequence in the remaining string? Provide a DP formulation using dp[i][j][d] as the max palindrome length in s[i..j] after exactly d deletions within that subrange. Include recurrences, base cases, reconstruction hints, and time/space complexities. Example: s = "abca", k = 1?

You're given a numeric string s of length n and an integer k. Split s into exactly k non-empty contiguous substrings; interpret each substring as a decimal number with no leading zeros unless the substring is '0'. Minimize the sum of these k numbers. Return the minimum sum and the cut positions (indices after which a cut occurs). Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t], recurrence, base cases, and reconstruction, plus time/space notes?

Grid path with constrained turns. You have an R x C grid with non-negative weights. Start at (0,0) and end at (R-1,C-1). You can move only right or down. You must make exactly k turns (a turn is when you switch from moving right to down or from down to right). Return the minimum path sum, or -1 if impossible. Propose a DP formulation using states dp[i][j][dir][t], with dir in {0,1} representing last move direction, t turns used. Include recurrences, base cases, reconstruction, and time/space analysis?

You're given a binary string s of length n and an integer k. Partition s into exactly k non-empty contiguous substrings. Each substring's cost is the number of transitions inside it (positions i where s[i] != s[i-1] within the substring). Return the minimum total cost and the k partition end indices. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the min cost to split the first i chars into t parts, recurrence dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + cost(p+1,i); base dp[i][1] = cost(1,i). Include reconstruction plan and complexity notes?

You're given an array A of length n representing per-minute engagement. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous time blocks in order (you may skip minutes between blocks). Each block [l..r] yields value min(A[l..r]) * (r-l+1). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks?

You're given a grid cost of size n x m. You start at (0,0) and must reach (n-1,m-1). You may move right, down, or diagonally down-right. Each diagonal move consumes one token from a budget of K; you may perform at most K diagonals in the path. What is the minimum total cost to reach the bottom-right, and what is the path (sequence of coordinates) taken? Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][j][t] as the minimum cost to reach (i,j) using exactly t diagonals, including recurrences, base cases, reconstruction, and a discussion of time/space?

You're given a string s of length n and an integer k. You may delete at most k characters to transform s into a palindrome. Return whether this is possible and, if so, the resulting palindrome. Propose a DP with dp[i][j] for minimum deletions on s[i..j], recurrences: if s[i]==s[j] then dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j-1]; else dp[i][j]=min(dp[i+1][j], dp[i][j-1])+1; base: dp[i][i]=0; dp[i][i-1]=0. Explain reconstruction, time/space, and how to recover the deletions?

Partition an array into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. The score of a subarray [l..r] is max(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r]). Maximize the total score and return the k blocks' boundaries. Provide a DP formulation with reconstruction and discuss time/space?

You are given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. The cost of a subarray [l..r] is floor((sum A[l..r])/(r-l+1)). Return the minimum total cost and the partition endpoints?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. Each subarray's cost is the absolute difference between its endpoints, i.e., cost([l..r]) = |A[l] - A[r]|. Return the minimum total cost and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + |A[p+1] - A[i]|, base dp[i][1] = |A[1] - A[i]|. Include reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

Given an array A[1..n] and integer k, partition into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. Each segment’s cost is (sum of the segment) × (minimum element in that segment). Return the maximum total cost and the k segment endpoints. Propose DP: dp[i][t] = max_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + (sum(p+1..i)) × minVal[p+1][i]. Include base cases, reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array prices[0..n-1] representing daily stock prices. You may perform at most k buy-sell transactions, but after each sale you must skip the next day (cooldown of 1). Return the maximum profit and the days of each trade. Propose a DP formulation with states noStock, hold, and cooldown per day and t, including recurrences, base cases, and a reconstruction plan?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. Each subarray's score is sum(subarray) * index_of_subarray_in_partition (1-based). Return the maximum total score and the endpoints of the k subarrays?

Context: you have a timeline of user activity represented by A[0..n-1], where A[i] is actions in minute i. You must select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous windows [l..r] to maximize the value sum over windows of (r-l+1) * sum(A[l..r]). Return the maximum value and the k windows. How would you design a DP formulation and reconstruction?

You’re given an array A of length n and an integer k. You must select exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays in order. Each subarray [l..r] yields score min(A[l..r]) * (r-l+1). Return the maximum total score and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = max_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + min(A[p+1..i]) * (i-p). Explain base cases, reconstruction, and time/space complexity, and mention preprocessing for range minima?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays in order. For each subarray [l..r], its value is min(A[l..r]) * sum(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = max_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + min(A[p+1..i]) * (prefixSum[i]-prefixSum[p]); outline base cases, reconstruction plan, and discuss time/space implications and potential optimizations?

You're given a numeric string s of length n and an integer k. You may insert exactly k-1 plus signs to split s into k non-empty numbers. Interpret each as decimal and maximize the sum. Return the maximum sum and the split indices. Provide a DP formulation with states dp[i][t] representing the max sum for the first i digits split into t numbers, transitions by last cut j in [t-1..i-1], base dp[i][1] = value(0,i), and include reconstruction, plus a complexity discussion on time/space?

You have an array revenue[0..n-1] representing daily revenue. Partition into at most k non-empty, contiguous blocks to minimize the maximum block sum. Provide a DP formulation with states and reconstruction; include base cases and time/space analysis, and show how to output the k cut points?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks. For each block [l..r], the block value is sum(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks (start and end indices). Propose a dynamic-programming formulation with dp[i][t] = max value for first i elements partitioned into t blocks, provide recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction plan; discuss time and space complexity?

You're given a string s of length n consisting of lowercase letters. Choose exactly k non-overlapping substrings that maximize the total length, with the constraint that each chosen substring can be rearranged to form a palindrome (i.e., its character counts allow at most one odd count). Return the maximum total length and the endpoints of the chosen substrings. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = max total length for first i chars using t substrings, including a fast feasibility test for s[p..i], base cases, and reconstruction plan; discuss time/space?

You are given an array A of length n and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays in order. The value of a subarray [l..r] is (sum(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r])). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the chosen subarrays?

You manage a CDN and have hourly revenue A[0..n-1]. You can place at most k maintenance windows, each a contiguous block with length between minLen and maxLen inclusive. Windows must be non-overlapping. You want to minimize the total revenue lost during maintenance, i.e., the sum of A over all chosen windows. Return the minimum lost revenue and the windows (endpoints). Propose a DP formulation with states i, t and reconstruction plan, including recurrences and base cases, and discuss time/space complexity?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. You must select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays to maximize the sum over blocks of value(l,r) = (sum(A[l..r])) * (min(A[l..r])). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k subarrays?

In a warehouse grid of size n x m, each cell has a traversal cost. You can move only right or down from (0,0) to (n-1,m-1). You have a one-time token to halve the cost of exactly one visited cell. Design an O(nm) DP to compute the minimum path cost after optimally using the discount, and describe the recurrences and a space-optimized implementation?

You're planning a delivery route along a straight street of n blocks. At block i you can advance up to jumps[i] blocks (at least 1). How many distinct routes reach block n-1 from block 0? If unreachable, return 0. Propose a dynamic-programming approach with dp[i] as ways to reach i and outline its time/space complexity, edge cases, and a brief correctness justification. How would you implement it?

You're building a daily workout planner. Over n days, you can pick Light (L) or Heavy (H) workouts, with a cooldown: after a Heavy, you must skip the next two days (no workouts). Given integers n and r, how many length-n sequences contain exactly r Heavy workouts and satisfy the cooldown rule? Provide a DP formulation with state dp[i][c][t] (days processed, cooldown days left, heavies used) and outline time/space complexity, edge cases, and a brief correctness justification?

You are given an array A of length n and an integer k. You must partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. For each subarray [l..r], score = number of distinct values present in A[l..r]. Return the maximum total score and the k-1 partition indices. Propose a DP: dp[i][t] = max over p in [t-1..i-1] of dp[p][t-1] + distinctCount(p+1, i). Include precomputation of distinct counts, base cases, and reconstruction. Explain time/space?

You're navigating a warehouse grid of size n x m. Each cell (i, j) has a risk value r[i][j] ≥ 0, where higher means less safe. You may move only right or down from (0,0) to (n-1,m-1). Devise a dynamic-programming solution to minimize the maximum risk encountered on the path (i.e., minimize max(r[i][j]) along the path). Define a suitable dp[i][j], give the recurrence and base cases, describe reconstruction of the path, and analyze time/space complexity. How would you handle blocked cells by setting r[i][j] = INF?

You're given an array A of length n representing daily demand forecasts. Partition the array into exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping contiguous campaigns. For a block [l..r], its value is (r-l+1) * max(A[l..r]) - sum(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the k blocks (endpoints). Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing max value using first i days and t campaigns, including transitions and reconstruction?

You're given a DAG with N nodes and M weighted edges, a start node s, an end node t, and an integer K. Find the maximum total weight of a path from s to t that uses exactly K edges. Return the weight and the path (node sequence). Propose a DP formulation with states DP[v][e], recurrences, base cases, reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given a rooted tree with N nodes, each node v has weight w[v]. Choose exactly K pairwise-disjoint connected subtrees (each subtree non-empty) to maximize the sum of weights of all covered nodes. Return the maximum total weight and the K subtrees' roots. Provide a DP formulation with per-node states, recurrences, and a reconstruction plan?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n). Partition A into exactly k non-empty, contiguous segments. Define cost(l, r) = max(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r]). Return the minimum total cost achievable and the k segment endpoints (start and end indices for each segment). Propose a dynamic programming formulation with appropriate states, recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction plan; discuss time and space complexity and possible optimizations?

You're building a text formatter. Given a list of word lengths L = [l1, l2, ..., ln] and a maximum line width W, wrap the words into lines so that all lines except the last incur a penalty of (W - usedWidth)^2, where usedWidth = sum of word lengths on the line plus spaces between words. The last line has 0 penalty. Propose a dynamic programming solution with dp[i] representing the minimum penalty for words i..n-1, specify the recurrence, reconstruction method, and time/space complexity. How would you implement it?

You're given an array A of length n with non-negative integers. You must select exactly k non-overlapping, non-empty subarrays in order (i1 <= j1 < i2 <= j2 < ... < ik <= n). The value of a subarray [l..r] is sum(A[l..r]) - max(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints (l, r) of each of the k subarrays. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = max total value using first i elements partitioned into t subarrays, where the t-th subarray ends at i, including recurrence, base cases, reconstruction, and time/space discussion?

You're given an array A[1..n] and an integer k. Partition into exactly k contiguous segments. The cost of a segment [t+1..i] is (sum(A[t+1..i]))^2. Return the minimum total cost and the partition indices. Propose DP: P as prefix sums, dp[i][j] = min_{t in [j-1..i-1]} dp[t][j-1] + (P[i]-P[t])^2, with base dp[0][0]=0. Explain reconstruction and discuss naive vs. optimized time, space, and edge cases?

You're given a string s of length n (lowercase) and an integer k. Partition s into exactly k non-empty contiguous substrings. Each substring's value is the number of distinct characters within it. Return the maximum total value and the substring endpoints. Provide a DP formulation and reconstruction approach?

You're given an array A[1..n] of daily potential revenue numbers. You may select exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping contiguous windows [l_j..r_j] for promotions, in order. Each window yields revenue sum(A[l_j..r_j]) * (r_j - l_j + 1). Return the maximum total revenue and the endpoints of the k windows. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the max revenue for first i days using t windows, the recurrence, base cases, and a reconstruction plan?

You're given an array A of length n with non-negative integers representing daily story points. You must partition the days into consecutive weeks, each containing 2–7 days. The cost of a week is (sum of that week's points − W)^2 where W is a fixed target. Return the minimum total cost to cover all days or INF if impossible. Propose a DP with dp[i] as min cost for first i days; dp[i] = min_{k=2..7, i-k>=0} dp[i-k] + (sum(i-k+1..i) − W)^2, using prefix sums for O(1) range sums. Reconstruct weeks and analyze time/space?

Partition string s of length n into exactly k non-empty contiguous substrings, where each substring's cost is the number of distinct characters it contains; what is the minimum total cost and the cut positions?

You're given an array A of length n and a non-negative daily cost c. You may schedule up to k non-overlapping campaigns, each campaign is a contiguous segment [l..r], and its profit equals sum(A[l..r]) - c*(r-l+1). Return the maximum total profit and the segments used. Propose a DP formulation and a reconstruction plan?

You're given an n x m grid. Each cell (i, j) has a color c[i][j] in [0, C-1] and a non-negative cost w[i][j]. Start at (0,0) and move to (n-1,m-1) with only right or down moves. You must visit at least one cell of every color that appears in the grid along your path. Return the minimum total cost to do so, or -1 if impossible. Describe a DP using dp[i][j][mask] where mask tracks visited colors; explain base cases, transitions from top/left, how to reconstruct the path, and complexity?

Given an array A of length n and an integer k, select exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays such that no two are adjacent (there is at least one index between blocks). For each block [l..r], its value is max(A[l..r]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best value using first i elements with t blocks, define the transition to enforce the required gap, include reconstruction pointers, and discuss time and space?

You're given a list of n task durations L. Partition the tasks into consecutive days (each day at least one task); the cost of a day is the maximum duration on that day. Devise a DP to minimize the total cost across all days. Define dp[i] as the minimum cost for the first i tasks, provide the recurrence, reconstruction method, and complexity. How would you implement it?

You're given an array A of length n of temperatures. You must partition into exactly k non-empty contiguous segments. The cost of a segment [l..r] is (max(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r])) * (r-l+1). Return the minimum total cost and the partition endpoints. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + (range(p+1,i)) * (i-p). Include base cases and reconstruction; discuss time/space?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. You may select exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping subarrays in increasing order. Each subarray's value is the sum of its elements. Return the maximum total sum and the endpoints of the k subarrays. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best sum using the first i elements with t blocks, the transitions, base cases, and how to reconstruct the endpoints; discuss time and space?

Given a circular array v[1..n] of non-negative values and an integer d≥1, pick a subset of indices such that the cyclic distance between any two chosen indices is at least d. Maximize the sum of selected values; return both the maximum sum and the number of distinct optimal subsets. Constraints: n ≤ 2e5, v[i] ≤ 1e9. Describe an O(n) DP solution with two cases for circularity and how you'd reconstruct counts?

Given an array A[1..n] and an integer k, select exactly k non-overlapping, contiguous blocks to maximize the sum of block contributions, where a block [l..r] contributes max(A[l..r]). Return the maximum sum and the k blocks (start/end). Propose a DP with dp[i][t] as best value using first i elements with t blocks, transitions using max(A[j..i]), include reconstruction pointers and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. The cost of a subarray [t+1..i] is (max(A[t+1..i])) * (i-t). Return the minimum total cost and the partition indices. Propose DP: dp[i][j] = min_{t in [j-1..i-1]} dp[t][j-1] + max(A[t+1..i]) * (i-t). Explain reconstruction, base cases, and time/space?

You are given an array workload[0..n-1] of non-negative integers representing forecasted daily work. You may boost at most k days by doubling that day's workload, with the constraint that boosts cannot occur on consecutive days. Compute the maximum total workload achievable and provide the list of boosted day indices?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k (1 <= k <= n). Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays that cover the entire array. The cost of a subarray is the maximum element within it. Return the minimum total cost and the endpoints (partition indices) of the k subarrays. Provide a DP formulation with recurrence, base cases, and reconstruction pointers; discuss time/space?

You're given an array A of non-negative integers representing task durations in order. You must schedule all n tasks into exactly m days. Each day can host a consecutive block with total duration <= D. The cost of a day is (sum of that day's durations)^2. Return the minimum total cost, or -1 if impossible? Propose a DP using dp[i][d] as min cost for first i tasks in d days, with transition dp[i][d] = min_{j<i, prefix[i]-prefix[j] <= D} dp[j][d-1] + (prefix[i]-prefix[j])^2. Include base cases, reconstruction, and time/space?

Given an array A[1..n] and an integer k, choose exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping contiguous blocks. For each block [l..r], you may replace all elements in the block by a single value x chosen to minimize the sum of absolute deviations within that block; the block cost is sum_{i=l}^r |A[i]-x|, achieved at x = median(A[l..r]). Return the minimum total cost and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation, including base cases, recurrences, and how to reconstruct the blocks; discuss time and space?

You have an array A of length n. Partition into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks. The cost of a block [t+1..i] is (max(A[t+1..i])) * (sum(A[t+1..i])). Return the minimum total cost and the partition indices. Propose a DP formulation, reconstruction strategy, and complexity analysis. Assume 1-based indexing?

You are given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. Partition the array into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks. Each block's value is the bitwise OR of its elements. Return the maximum possible sum of block values and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a dynamic programming formulation with dp[i][t] as the max sum for first i elements formed into t blocks, transitions using OR(A[j..i-1]), base cases, reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array prices[0..n-1]. You may complete at most k buy-sell transactions (one share at a time, can't hold more than one). Return the maximum profit and the days of each trade. Propose a DP formulation with states cash[i][t] and hold[i][t], include recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array profits[0..n-1] of positive integers and an integer k. You may select at most k days, with the constraint that no two selected days are consecutive. Return the maximum total profit and the indices of the chosen days. Provide a DP formulation with states i and t, recurrence, base cases, and a reconstruction strategy?

You have an array of task difficulties A of length n. Partition it into exactly m non-empty contiguous chapters. Each chapter cost equals the maximum difficulty within that chapter. Return the minimum total cost and a valid partition (chapter end indices). Propose a DP: dp[i][j] = min_{t in [j-1..i-1]} dp[t][j-1] + max(A[t..i-1]), with base dp[i][1] = max(A[0..i-1]). Explain reconstruction, base cases, and time/space?

You are given an n x m grid profits[i][j] of non-negative integers. From (0,0) to (n-1,m-1) you can move only right or down. You may apply up to p power-ups on at most p cells along the path, each power-up doubling that cell’s value. Return the maximum possible profit and the path. Propose a DP with dp[i][j][t] representing max profit to (i,j) using t power-ups, plus recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction?

You're given an n x m grid of digits grid[i][j] in [0..9]. You may move only right or down from (0,0) to (n-1,m-1). Define a path score as the number of times the next cell's digit is strictly larger than the previous cell's digit along the path. Return the maximum score and a valid path (as coordinates or directions). Propose a dynamic programming formulation with recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] of integers representing daily profits. Choose exactly k non-overlapping subarrays (they may touch at endpoints) to maximize the sum of their elements. Return the maximum total sum and the endpoints of each chosen subarray. Outline a DP: define dp[i][t] and endHere[i][t], provide recurrences, base cases, and a plan to reconstruct the subarray endpoints; discuss time and space?

You're given a tree with N nodes (N up to 2e5). Each node i has a value val[i]. Find a connected subtree of exactly K nodes that maximizes the sum of values. Return the maximum sum and the node set. Propose a DP formulation with dp[u][s] = max sum of a connected subtree of size s that contains u and lies entirely within u's subtree when the tree is rooted at 1; include reconstruction, base cases, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks. For a block [l..r], compute value = (sum(A[l..r])) * (distinct_count(A[l..r])) where distinct_count is the number of distinct elements in the block. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the max value for first i elements partitioned into t blocks, transitions using a new block [j..i-1], include reconstruction pointers, and discuss time and space?

You're given a string s of length n consisting of lowercase letters. Partition s into at most k non-empty contiguous substrings. The cost of a substring is the number of distinct characters in that substring. Return the minimum total cost and one valid partition (end indices). Propose a DP formulation with recurrence dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + cost(p, i-1) where cost(p, q) is the number of distinct letters in s[p..q]. Explain reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

Given a digit string s of length n and an integer k, partition s into exactly k non-empty substrings by placing k-1 cuts. Each substring is a decimal number with no leading zeros (except '0'). The partition's value is the sum of the numbers. Return the maximum sum and the cut positions. Propose a DP: define dp[i][t] = max sum for first i chars partitioned into t blocks; value(j,i) is the integer of s[j..i-1]. Provide recurrences, base cases, reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A of length n and an integer k. Partition A into exactly k non-empty contiguous subarrays. Each subarray's cost is max(A[l..r]) - min(A[l..r]). Return the minimum total cost and one valid partition (end indices). Propose a DP: dp[i][t] = min_{p in [t-1..i-1]} dp[p][t-1] + (max(A[p..i-1]) - min(A[p..i-1])); base: dp[i][1] = max(A[0..i-1]) - min(A[0..i-1]). Explain reconstruction, base cases, and time/space complexity?

You're given a binary string s and an integer k. You may flip at most k bits to maximize the length of a contiguous substring of '1's. Return the maximum length and the substring's start/end indices. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] as the maximum length of a substring ending at i using t flips, include recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array nums of length n and an integer m. Partition nums into exactly m non-empty contiguous blocks. Each block [l..r] yields value max(nums[l..r]) * (r-l+1). Return the maximum total score and the endpoints of the blocks. Propose a dynamic programming formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best score using first i elements partitioned into t blocks, and reconstruct the endpoints. Provide base cases, transitions, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A of length n. Partition the array into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks. Define the value of a block [l..r] as the sum of all positive increases within that block, i.e., sum_{i=l+1..r} max(0, A[i]-A[i-1]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best value for first i elements formed into t blocks, show the transition using prefix sums of positive increases, base cases, and reconstruction plan?

You have an array A[0..n-1]. Partition it into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks. Each block's value is the number of inversions inside that block (i.e., pairs i<j within the block with A[i] > A[j]). Return the maximum possible sum of block values and the block boundaries. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] as the max inversions sum for first i elements into t blocks, use invCost(j, i-1) as the transition, include reconstruction pointers, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array daily[0..n-1] of non-negative integers representing daily revenue. You may run at most k non-overlapping advertising campaigns; each campaign must cover a contiguous window of days. The net value of a campaign on window [l..r] is sum(daily[l..r]) - C, where C is a fixed cost per campaign. Return the maximum total revenue and the endpoints of the chosen windows. Provide a DP formulation with dp[i][t] = max revenue using first i days with at most t campaigns, transitions for ending a campaign at i, base cases, reconstruction, and time/space analysis?

You are given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. Partition the array into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks in order. The value of a block [l..r] is the maximum subarray sum contained within that block (i.e., max over p,q with l≤p≤q≤r of sum A[p..q]). Return the maximum possible sum of block values and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP with precomputation of max-subarray sums for all intervals, the dp[i][t], base cases, reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

Given an array A[0..n-1] of integers, partition into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks in order. The value of a block [l..r] is the number of distinct elements present in that block. Return the maximum possible sum of the k block values, and provide the endpoints of each block?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] of feature flags (bitmasks). Partition the array into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks in order. Each block's value is the bitwise OR of all elements in that block. Return the maximum possible sum of the k block values and the endpoints of the blocks. How would you formulate and solve this?

Partition an array into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks in order. The value of a block [l..r] is the number of distinct elements in that subarray. Return the maximum sum of block values and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best value using first i elements with t blocks, define the transition, reconstruction pointers, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] of integers. Choose exactly k indices i1<...<ik to form a subsequence. The cost is sum_{t=1}^{k-1} |A[i_{t+1}] - A[i_t]|. Return the minimum possible cost and the chosen indices?

You are given an n x m grid of nonnegative integers rewards[i][j]. You start at (0,0) and may move only right or down to reach (n-1,m-1). You may make at most T turns (direction changes). What is the maximum sum of rewards along the path? Provide a DP formulation with state dp[i][j][t][dir], recurrences, base cases, and a reconstruction plan?

You’re given an N x M grid with non-negative values. Start at (0,0) and move to (N-1,M-1) by only right or down. You have energy E; each step costs 1 energy. Some cells are power-ups that reset energy to E, usable at most R times in the path. Maximize the sum of visited cell values. Propose a DP with states dp[i][j][r][e], recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction; discuss time/space and optimizations?

You are given an array arr[0..n-1] of integers representing daily revenue. You may schedule exactly k ad campaigns on non-overlapping blocks of consecutive days, with at least one day gap between campaigns. Each campaign [l..r] yields revenue equal to sum(arr[l..r]). Return the maximum total revenue and the endpoints of the k campaigns. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] representing the best revenue using first i days with t campaigns, include recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given a string s of length n and an integer k. You may perform at most k substitutions (change any character to any lowercase letter). After edits, maximize the length of the longest palindromic subsequence (LPS) of the modified string. Return the maximum LPS length and a concrete edit plan (positions and letters). Propose a DP with dp[i][j][e] representing the LPS length of s[i..j] with at most e edits; provide recurrences, base cases, and a reconstruction plan for the edited string?

Given an array A[0..n-1], integer k, and minimum block length L, choose exactly k non-overlapping contiguous blocks, each of length at least L, in order. The value of a block is the sum of A within that block. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the blocks. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] representing the best total value for first i elements partitioned into t blocks, define the transition over block length s>=L, include reconstruction, and discuss time/space?

You're given an m x n grid of non-negative values. Start at (0,0) and move only right or down. You may perform at most k teleports, each teleport instantly moves to any cell in the same row or same column, continuing moves from there. Each visited cell's value is collected once. Return the maximum sum and the teleport endpoints?

You're given an array A[0..n-1]. You may choose exactly k non-overlapping contiguous subarrays. For a subarray [l..r], its value is (sum(A[l..r])) * (r-l+1). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] as the best value using first i elements with t blocks, where the transition is either skip i or end a block at i: dp[i][t] = max(dp[i-1][t], max_{l<=i} dp[l-1][t-1] + (S[i]-S[l-1])*(i-l+1)). Include reconstruction and discuss time/space?

Given an array A[1..n] and an integer k, plus a fixed per-element penalty lambda > 0, partition the array into exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping contiguous blocks in order. For a block [l..r], value = sum(A[l..r]) - lambda*(r-l+1). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] as the best value using first i elements in t blocks, derive transitions, base cases, and a reconstruction plan, and discuss time/space?

You're given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. Partition into exactly k non-empty, non-overlapping contiguous blocks in order. The value of a block [l..r] is max(A[l..r]) * (r-l+1). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP with precomputed cost[l][r], a dp[i][t], and reconstruction pointers; discuss time/space and practical optimizations?

Given an array A[0..n-1] of integers and integers k and c, select exactly k non-empty, non-adjacent subarrays (at least one index gap between blocks). Each block [l..r] yields value sum(A[l..r]) - c. Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP with dp[i][t] as the best value using first i elements with t blocks, derive transitions, and discuss reconstruction and complexity?

You have an n x m grid with non-negative weights. Start at (0,0) and move to (n-1,m-1) using only right or down moves. You may use at most k turns (direction changes). Return the maximum path sum and one optimal path's coordinates. Propose a DP formulation with states dp[i][j][t][dir], recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time and space complexity?

You’re given an array A[0..n-1] and an integer k. Partition the array into exactly k non-empty contiguous blocks in order. For each block [l..r], its value is the maximum subarray sum that starts at l and ends at or before r (i.e., max over e in [l..r] sum A[l..e]). Return the maximum total value and the endpoints of the k blocks. Propose a DP formulation with dp[i][t] and the precomputation of bestStartAt[l][i], include recurrences, base cases, and reconstruction, and discuss time/space complexity?
How do you organize Cypress fixtures for component testing, and what are the key patterns for managing test data dependencies across multiple test suites?
